summary.experiments: 覆盖 3 个模型家族、2B 到 14B。关键结果是：普通 answer-confidence 能预测答对与否，但几乎看不出问题是否可答；hidden-state probe 则相反，对 false-premise 问题尤其有效。在 CREPE 上，显式置信或真假判断接近随机，而 hidden-state probe 可达 0.69-0.77 AUROC；且这一盲点不会随模型变大自然消失。摘要还指出“让模型检查前提”的简单指令会引入过度质疑，损伤正常问题处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM abstention is really one phenomenon, or whether refusing wrong answers and refusing unanswerable/false-premise questions are two distinct axes.
summary_en.importance: This matters for both post-training and model analysis. The contribution is not a new alignment algorithm but a cleaner decomposition: current refusal/confidence schemes conflate two different capabilities, and models may internally represent answerability failures without surfacing them in generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across five instruction-tuned models, the paper separates answer correctness from question answerability. It compares standard answer confidence, P(IK), P(True), explicit premise-check prompting, and a linear probe on hidden states. The analysis focuses on false-premise questions and on why explicit premise-check instructions can backfire.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers three model families from 2B to 14B. The main result is that answer confidence predicts correctness but is nearly blind to answerability, while a hidden-state probe does the reverse. On CREPE false-premise questions, explicit confidence-style signals stay near chance, whereas a hidden-state probe reaches 0.69-0.77 AUROC. The blind spot also does not disappear with scale.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 refusal/calibration 的问题分解：别再拿一个 confidence 头包打天下，先看 CREPE 结果和 hidden-state probe，对 reward 设计有直接影响。
recommendation.en: This should change how you decompose refusal and calibration: one confidence head is not enough—read the CREPE results and hidden-state probe analysis before designing rewards or abstention heads.

institutions: City St George’s, University of London

paper.title: What Predicts Correctness in Text-to-SQL? A Selective-Prediction Study
paper.abstract: Evaluating uncertainty in AI-generated SQL queries requires estimating whether a query is correct, where correct means it executes to the same result as a human-written reference. We study which signals predict correctness on hard multi-table text-to-SQL, using AUROC to measure how well each ranks correct queries above incorrect ones. On BIRD and Spider, black-box signals such as string, structural, and execution self-consistency, a schema-relevance score, and query executability all fall betwee

summary.core_problem: 研究在 text-to-SQL 场景中，哪些信号最能预测模型生成 SQL 的正确性，并支持 selective prediction 与 abstention。
summary.importance: 贡献属于评测与验证方法：它不是提升 text-to-SQL 生成本身，而是系统比较黑盒、白盒和 verifier/judge 信号对 correctness 预测的上限，结论对 LLM judge、校准和 verifier 设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 correctness 预测建模为排序/校准问题，比较字符串自一致性、结构自一致性、执行自一致性、schema relevance、可执行性以及白盒 log-probability 等信号，并引入不同提供商的 LLM judge 及其集成作为 verification-based predictor。
summary.experiments: 在 BIRD 和 Spider 两个较难的 text-to-SQL 基准上评估，黑盒与白盒信号 AUROC 大致都落在 0.61-0.68，string self-consistency 最强约 0.675，log-probability 约 0.67；verification-based judge 可到 0.72-0.78，双提供商 ensemble 达到 0.82 AUROC，ECE 约 0.03，并能形成有用的 abstention frontier。不是基座训练论文，但对“judge 比 token-level confidence 更有用”这一点给了较干净的证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which signals best predict whether a generated SQL query is actually correct, enabling selective prediction and abstention in text-to-SQL.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-and-verification contribution rather than a generation method. Its value lies in a fairly clean comparison of black-box, white-box, and judge-based correctness predictors, which is relevant to LLM judges and calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study frames correctness prediction as a ranking/calibration problem and compares string, structural, and execution self-consistency, schema relevance, executability, white-box log-probability, and LLM-judge-based verification, including cross-provider ensembles.
summary_en.experiments: On BIRD and Spider, most black-box and white-box signals cluster around 0.61-0.68 AUROC, with string self-consistency at about 0.675 and log-probability around 0.67. Verification-based judges reach 0.72-0.78, and a two-provider ensemble reaches 0.82 AUROC with ECE around 0.03, supporting useful abstention frontiers. Not a pretraining paper, but a reasonably clean result on judge-vs-confidence signals.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你别过度迷信 logprob 置信度；只看结果表和 judge ensemble 部分就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a useful reminder that logprob is a weak confidence proxy; read the main results table and the judge-ensemble section.

paper.title: Evaluating LLM Uncertainty in Long-Form Generation Using Deterministic Ground Truth
paper.abstract: As LLMs generate increasingly long outputs, effective uncertainty estimation must identify errors at fine-grained levels rather than discard entire responses. While such methods exist, evaluating uncertainty at any resolution (token to an entire generation) is challenging and highly sensitive to label imperfections, making zero-noise benchmarks essential; yet, long-form generation benchmarks tend to rely on fallible labels rather than deterministic ground truth. We introduce Single-answer Atomic

summary.core_problem: 长文本生成场景下的细粒度不确定性评估缺乏无噪声基准。现有长文本基准依赖易错的人工或LLM生成标签，输出分解与验证环节的噪声会扭曲不确定性度量、系统性偏差排序指标，同时无法支持从原子单元到完整响应的多粒度精确评估。
summary.importance: 提供了无噪、可无限生成、抗污染的长文本细粒度不确定性评估基准，可用于预训练或后训练阶段模型校准效果的精确验证；对50+模型的实测揭示的推理权衡、细粒度置信度失效模式等结论，为理解LLM不确定性行为、设计预训练校准方法提供实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: SALT包含6个程序生成的任务，覆盖逻辑、数学、代码、翻译、多针插草堆等领域，每个任务都有唯一确定性的长文本基准真值，无需外部评审。它支持多粒度的正确性、校准与排序评估，可生成近乎无限的实例以避免模型进化带来的基准污染。
summary.experiments: 评估了50余款主流LLM，包括GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-Pro、Qwen-3、GLM-4.7、MiniMax M2.5。核心发现包括：1）推理机制（思维链/推理模型）存在“推理权衡”：提升生成精度的同时会系统性损害置信度排序能力；2）置信度排序存在高分辨率失效模式：原始置信度信号经常无法区分正确与错误的原子单元，即便粗粒度排序仍有信息量；3）未来生成的正确性由两个可分离的因素驱动：前缀错误的传播（由全局而非局部上下文正确性主导），以及答案上下文长度增加带来的有限退化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1节研究动机与现有方法局限、SALT基准的任务设计与生成方式章节、实验部分的核心发现。跳过各个任务的具体实现细节、完整的模型性能表格与细碎的消融结果。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Fine-grained uncertainty estimation for long-form LLM generation lacks zero-noise evaluation benchmarks. Existing long-form benchmarks rely on fallible human or LLM-generated labels, where noise from output decomposition and verification distorts uncertainty metrics and systematically biases ranking metrics like AUROC. Multi-granularity evaluation spanning atomic units to full responses also cannot be reliably supported under current paradigms.
summary_en.importance: Presents SALT, a contamination-free, deterministically generated benchmark for fine-grained long-form uncertainty evaluation that enables precise measurement of LLM calibration and ranking across granularities. Empirical findings from 50+ models, including reasoning trade-offs and fine-grained confidence failure modes, provide empirical reference for designing pretraining calibration methods and understanding LLM uncertainty behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: SALT comprises six procedurally generated tasks covering logic, mathematics, code, translation, and multi-needle-in-haystack, each with a single deterministic long-form ground truth that requires no external judges. It supports multi-granularity evaluation of correctness, calibration, and ranking, with effectively unlimited instance generation to avoid benchmark contamination as models evolve.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated over 50 contemporary LLMs including GPT-5.1, Gemini-3-Pro, Qwen-3, GLM-4.7, and MiniMax M2.5. Key insights: 1) Reasoning mechanisms (CoT/reasoning models) introduce a "reasoning trade-off" that improves precision but systematically degrades confidence ranking; 2) Confidence ranking exhibits a high-resolution failure mode where raw confidence signals fail to separate correct from incorrect atomic units even when coarser-grained ranking remains informative; 3) Future correctness is driven by two separable factors: error propagation from corrupted prefixes (dominated by global rather than local context correctness) and bounded degradation from increasing answer-context length.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 (motivation and limitations of prior work), the SALT benchmark design and task generation section, and key experimental findings. Skip detailed task implementation, exhaustive model performance tables, and granular ablation results. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 设计和 atomic-vs-line 结果；它会修正对长文本置信度可迁移性的乐观假设。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design and atomic-vs-line results; it tempers the usual optimism about transferable confidence scores in long-form generation.

paper.title: Consistent but Miscalibrated: Evaluating LLM Limitations for Risk Communication in Natural Language
paper.abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as post-hoc explainers of AI-generated outputs, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably communicate probabilistic information in natural language. For this role to be viable, models must produce identical verbal descriptions for identical inputs, and select descriptions that accurately reflect the magnitude of the underlying numerical quantities. We evaluate whether nine LLMs meet these requirements within a two-stage prediction pipeline, in which an upstr

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 能否把上游模型的概率和不确定性，用稳定且校准的自然语言风险描述表达出来。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测与可靠性分析。它关注 LLM 作为后验解释器时的自然语言概率校准问题，对安全评估和模型输出解释有用，但与预训练 recipe 的连接较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 构造两阶段预测管线：先用 Beta 分布按 mode 和 prior sample size 模拟上游模型概率输出，再要求 LLM 在六个领域语境和十个 temperature 设置下选择自然语言描述，并重复实验以测量一致性和校准性。
summary.experiments: 评估九个 LLM，每个条件重复十次。主要发现是模型通常能给出一致描述，但描述与真实概率幅度存在校准偏差。摘要未列出具体模型名单、误差指标和逐模型结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 McGill University、Chandar Research Lab、Polytechnique Montréal、Mila，Sarath Chandar 是 Mila / CIFAR AI Chair 相关研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can express upstream probabilistic predictions and uncertainty in natural language both consistently and with proper calibration.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and reliability-analysis contribution. It is relevant to LLMs as post-hoc explainers of model outputs, though its connection to pretraining recipes is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a two-stage prediction pipeline: upstream probabilistic outputs are simulated from Beta distributions parameterized by mode and prior sample size, and LLMs are prompted to choose verbal descriptors under six domain contexts and ten temperature settings, with repeated trials to measure consistency and calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Nine LLMs are evaluated, with each experiment repeated ten times. The main reported finding is that models are generally consistent but miscalibrated in mapping probabilities to verbal risk descriptors. The abstract does not list the exact models, metrics, or per-model numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with McGill University, Chandar Research Lab, Polytechnique Montréal, and Mila. Sarath Chandar is associated with Mila and CIFAR AI Chair.

recommendation.zh: 结论像一个可靠性 sanity check；看实验设计即可，别把它外推到预训练校准机制。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a reliability sanity check; read the setup, but do not over-interpret it as pretraining calibration theory.

institutions: Mila – Québec Artificial Intelligence Institute, Montréal, H2S 3H1
Chandar Research Lab, Polytechnique Montréal, Montréal, H3T 1J4

paper.title: On the effectiveness of reward functions in reinforcement learning for confidence calibration of large language models
paper.abstract: In this paper, we consider the setting where large language models (LLMs) are trained using reinforcement learning (RL) to simultaneously improve reasoning accuracy and verbalize its confidence. Our reward scheme uses two functions for rewarding confidence verbalized by the LLM: one when the LLM is correct and a different one when the LLM is incorrect. With a poorly designed reward scheme, the LLM may be incentivized to answer incorrectly so that it can be confident that its answer is indeed inc

summary.core_problem: 研究RL用于LLM置信度校准时，奖励函数设计不当会引发「置信度奖励黑客」现象——模型故意答错问题以获得更高奖励，同时需要在不损失推理准确率的前提下实现良好的置信度校准。
summary.importance: RL对齐与置信度校准交叉领域的基础工作，明确了置信度奖励黑客的定义，推导了不可黑客化奖励方案的理论边界，对RL后训练阶段的奖励设计有直接指导意义，也能为预训练后期引入校准信号提供设计准则。
summary.technical_approach: 将奖励方案定义为答对时的置信度依赖函数f(c)与答错时的置信度依赖函数g(c)组成的二元组；理论推导了不可黑客化奖励方案的充要条件，保证「尽力答对并诚实上报置信度」的期望奖励始终高于「故意答错」的期望；进一步设计了覆盖「偏好欠置信」到「偏好过置信」的连续奖励方案谱系，允许根据应用场景调整准确率与校准效果的权衡。
summary.experiments: 在实用推理数据集上验证，使用不在不可黑客化集合内的奖励方案时，LLM会选择性故意答错部分问题以最大化奖励；不同非黑客化奖励方案对应不同的准确率-校准权衡曲线，奖励方案选型可作为调优超参数。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第2章问题建模与理论推导部分，以及附录A.1的置信度奖励黑客具体示例；实验部分可泛读不同奖励方案的权衡对比，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates reward function design flaws in RL-based LLM confidence calibration that trigger "confidence reward hacking" — a phenomenon where models intentionally answer questions incorrectly to maximize reward, while addressing the need to achieve solid calibration without sacrificing reasoning accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Foundational work at the intersection of RL alignment and confidence calibration. It formalizes the definition of confidence reward hacking, derives theoretical boundaries for non-hackable reward schemes, provides direct guidance for reward design in RL post-training, and offers design principles for introducing calibration signals during late-stage pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines a reward scheme as a tuple of two confidence-dependent functions: f(c) for correct answers and g(c) for incorrect answers. Theoretically derives the necessary and sufficient conditions for non-hackable schemes, which guarantee the expected reward of answering optimally and reporting confidence honestly is always higher than that of intentional wrong answers. Further designs a continuous spectrum of non-hackable schemes ranging from underconfidence-preferred to overconfidence-preferred, enabling application-specific tradeoffs between accuracy and calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically validates on practical reasoning datasets that LLMs trained with hackable reward schemes selectively answer some questions incorrectly to maximize reward. Different non-hackable schemes produce distinct accuracy-calibration tradeoff curves, confirming reward scheme selection as a valid tuning hyperparameter.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (problem formulation and theoretical derivation) and Appendix A.1 (concrete examples of confidence reward hacking). Skim experiment sections for tradeoff comparisons across schemes. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 RLHF/RLVR 的人该看：它提醒你 reward 不是“调个系数”这么简单，先检查是否存在自信答错也能拿高分的漏洞，再谈 calibration。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you design RL rewards: it shows confidence calibration is not a coefficient-tuning problem but a reward-spec issue that can literally pay the model to be wrong.

paper.title: Bayesian Sparse Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Uncertainty Estimation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities, but their task-specific fine-tuning is notoriously plagued by overconfidence, severely hindering trustworthy deployment. We propose Data-Adaptive Lower-Rank Adaptation (DALorRA), a simple and effective variational Bayesian sparse framework that shifts the paradigm of uncertainty quantification from the dense parameter space to the lightweight rank level of low-rank adaptation (LoRA). With the insight that LoRA essentially ag

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM 任务微调中，如何在不牺牲性能的情况下更好地估计不确定性并缓解过度自信。
summary.importance: 这是 LoRA 微调与不确定性估计的结合，属于后训练方法。对预训练研究员不是核心阅读，但对理解参数高效微调中的容量控制、校准与 ensemble-like 推断有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DALorRA，把贝叶斯稀疏建模从 dense parameter space 转移到 LoRA 的 rank 维度上：将 LoRA 看作多个 rank-one 分量的聚合，对 rank 维施加随机 masking 和变分贝叶斯稀疏化，从而在训练时正则化有效容量，在推理时获得类似集成的校准效果。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多项实验中显著改善 calibration，同时不损害 reasoning accuracy；但未在摘要中给出底座模型规模、任务类型、与哪些 uncertainty baselines 比较以及提升幅度。更适合作为 PEFT+uncertainty 的方法备查，而非基座研究主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to improve uncertainty estimation and reduce overconfidence in task-specific LLM fine-tuning without hurting task performance.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method combining LoRA with uncertainty estimation. It is not central reading for pretraining researchers, but it may still be useful for thinking about capacity control, calibration, and ensemble-like inference in parameter-efficient adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed DALorRA moves Bayesian sparsity from the dense parameter space to the LoRA rank dimension. Treating LoRA as an aggregation of rank-one components, it applies stochastic masking and variational Bayesian sparsification over ranks, regularizing effective capacity during training and yielding ensemble-like calibration at inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims strong calibration gains without sacrificing reasoning accuracy, but does not specify base model sizes, task suites, uncertainty baselines, or effect sizes. It is better viewed as a PEFT-plus-uncertainty method to keep on file rather than a core foundation-model paper.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不大，但“把贝叶斯放到 LoRA rank 维而不是全参数空间”这个建模点还算干净；只看方法设定与校准表即可。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but the move from full-parameter Bayesian treatment to LoRA-rank Bayesian sparsity is a clean idea; read the method setup and calibration tables only.

paper.title: Scaling with Confidence: Calibrating Confidence of LLMs for Adaptive Test Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced their performance on reasoning and question-answering tasks. However, prevailing RL reward designs typically prioritize response correctness, neglecting to incentivize models to express their confidence accurately. This leads to a critical problem: performance gains are often accompanied by poor calibration between confidence and accuracy, misleading models to overconfidently hallucinate when uncert

summary.core_problem: RL 训练 LLM 时奖励只看正确性，不鼓励模型表达真实置信度，导致推理模型校准差、在不确定时过度自信并产生幻觉，进而无法可靠做自适应 test-time 计算分配。
summary.importance: 把置信度校准作为显式 RL 奖励项，服务于自适应 test-time scaling 的可调度性，属于对齐/后训练对 scaling 接口的小改进。
summary.technical_approach: C3RL 在正确性奖励之外加两项：置信度校准奖励（对齐输出置信度与真实正确率）、数据集参考准确率奖励；据此训练出可用于自适应展开/重试的校准模型。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个文本+多模态数据集上评估，声称在不损失准确率的同时改善校准，相对现有校准方法在性能与校准两方面更优，具体参数量和训练 setup 摘要未给出。

summary_en.core_problem: RL training of LLMs rewards correctness only, producing poorly calibrated models that are overconfident on uncertain inputs, which breaks adaptive test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.importance: Adds an explicit confidence-calibration reward term to RL so that post-trained models can be reliably used for adaptive test-time scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: C3RL combines three rewards: correctness, confidence calibration (aligning stated confidence with empirical accuracy), and a dataset-informed reference-accuracy reward, yielding calibrated models suitable for adaptive generation/retry policies.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 text and multimodal datasets, reporting improved calibration without accuracy loss and outperforming prior calibration methods; model scales and training details not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把校准做成 RL 奖励的思路是合理的工程补充，但 setup 偏后训练；只看 §3 奖励定义和校准曲线就够，不改变 pretrain 认知。
recommendation.en: A reasonable post-training patch (calibration as RL reward) with limited bearing on pretrain; read §3 for the reward design and the calibration curves, don't expect new pretrain insights.

paper.title: Verifiable Rewards for Calibrated Probabilistic Forecasting
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can in principle train calibrated probabilistic forecasters, since a proper scoring rule such as the Brier score is computed from outcomes alone and is minimized in expectation by the true probability. In practice it degrades calibration, and existing remedies address epistemic uncertainty, where a model's confidence accompanies a verifiably correct or incorrect answer. We study aleatoric forecasting, where the forecast itself is the output and the

summary.core_problem: 用可验证奖励（RLVR）训练概率预测模型时，为什么对单次随机结果做奖励会让概率校准恶化，以及如何在 aleatoric uncertainty（输出本身就是概率、标签只是一次随机采样）场景下获得校准良好的预测。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对理解 RL post-training 在概率估计任务上的失败模式有直接参考价值，尤其是两个点：一是高方差的逐样本奖励会把策略拉向单次实现而非真实条件概率；二是 policy gradient 作用在 chain-of-thought token 上会污染推理，让文字理由与最终概率脱钩。这两个机制与通用 LLM 的校准、RL 训练中 reasoning 被 reward hacking 的问题相通。
summary.technical_approach: 任务选的是 NFL 比赛中逐档进攻的实时胜率预测。状态包含比分、剩余时间、档数距离、码位、持球方、赛前让分；标签只是该场比赛最终胜负这一次伯努利观测。作者发现直接对逐 play 的 Brier score 做 RL 会通过两条路径破坏校准：第一，单次结果噪声太大，对该结果打分会把梯度引向偶然发生的结局；第二，如果模型先生成推理再输出概率，梯度回传到 reasoning token 会重写思维链，使其不再支持最终概率。修复方法对应两点：第一，奖励不使用单次 outcome，而使用基于历史数据分桶估计的状态条件经验胜率，提供一个可验证、不带单样本标签噪声的目标；第二，要么直接预测概率而不生成 CoT，要么在答案 token 上施加梯度 mask，只让最终答案位置接收策略梯度，保持 reasoning 不被优化扭曲。
summary.experiments: 基座模型为 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，不经过 SFT，直接做 RL。训练集是 2015–2022 赛季，验证集 2023，测试集 2024。直接预测版本在测试集上 ECE 为 0.029，与博彩市场的 0.027 接近，Brier score 追平前沿零样本模型和表格经验估计器；博彩市场剩余优势主要来自模型看不到的现场实时信息。使用经验胜率作为奖励时，在 held-out 比赛上 Brier 距市场仅差 0.007。若不对 CoT 做梯度隔离，训练会把 ECE 从 0.19 恶化到 0.30；使用 answer-span gradient mask 后，推理与最终概率不一致的比例从 22.4% 降到 4.4%，sharpness 仅有小幅损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 introduction 与 Section 4 中两个失败机制的拆分：一个失败来自奖励噪声，一个失败来自 CoT 上的梯度污染。图表重点看 Figure 1 的训练对比和 ablation 中 full-completion gradient 与 answer-masked gradient 的校准差异。对做 RL/verifiable reward 的读者，值得关注“把高方差 outcome 换成状态条件经验估计”这一操作在其他随机性任务上的可迁移性。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。
summary.authors_note: Jasper Research，具体作者信息从提供文本中无法完全确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Why reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fails to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts when the reward is scored against single stochastic outcomes, and how to fix this failure under aleatoric uncertainty, where the model outputs a probability and the label is only one realized draw.
summary_en.importance: The paper gives a clean dissection of two failure modes that are relevant beyond sports forecasting: high-variance per-sample rewards pull the policy toward realized outcomes rather than the true conditional probability, and policy gradients applied to chain-of-thought tokens corrupt the reasoning so that stated probabilities no longer follow from the argument. Both mechanisms speak directly to broader concerns about calibration and reward hacking in RL post-training of LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The testbed is in-game win probability for NFL plays. The state encodes score margin, time remaining, down and distance, field position, possession, and the public pregame spread; the label is the single realized win/loss outcome. Direct RL on the per-play Brier score decalibrates the model for two reasons. First, one outcome is a noisy Bernoulli draw from the unobserved true rate, so the reward has high variance and chases the realized result. Second, when the model generates reasoning before the answer, the policy gradient rewrites the reasoning tokens into incoherent arguments that no longer support the stated probability. The fix is twofold: replace the per-play outcome with a state-bucketed empirical win rate estimated from historical data as a verifiable, low-variance reward target, and either drop chain-of-thought and predict directly or mask the gradient so that only answer tokens receive policy gradients.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is trained without SFT on 2015–2022 seasons, selected on 2023, and evaluated on held-out 2024 games. Direct prediction reaches an ECE of 0.029, close to the betting market at 0.027, and matches a frontier zero-shot model as well as a tabular estimator on Brier score; the remaining edge of the market is attributed to live in-game information unavailable to all public-state models. The empirical-rate reward is within 0.007 Brier of the market on held-out games. Training the full completion under the rate target degrades ECE from 0.19 to 0.30, while confining gradients to answer tokens keeps calibration near the market. Gradient masking on the answer span reduces the rate at which the stated probability is unsupported by the reasoning from 22.4% to 4.4%, with only a small loss in sharpness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, with attention to the two-way decomposition of failure in the introduction and Section 4: reward noise versus CoT corruption by gradients. Focus on Figure 1 and the ablations comparing full-completion gradients with answer-masked gradients. Readers working on RLVR or calibration should ask whether the empirical-rate reward trick transfers to other aleatoric prediction settings. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Jasper Research; full author details are not fully confirmed from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: RLHF 做推理/预测类任务时奖励噪声是共性痛点，重点看 §3 的状态条件奖励构造与梯度掩码设计。
recommendation.en: Reward noise is a shared pain point when applying RLHF to reasoning/forecasting tasks; focus on §3 for state-conditioned reward construction and gradient masking design.

paper.title: When Calibration Rankings Reverse: Accuracy-Controlled Evaluation for Fair Comparison of LLMs
paper.abstract: Calibration evaluates whether a model confidence aligns with its empirical accuracy. Existing studies often compare the calibration of different large language models using global calibration metrics such as Expected Calibration Error and Brier Score. We begin by showing, both theoretically and empirically, that such comparisons are confounded by differences in model accuracy. For fairer cross-model comparison, we then propose ACE, an accuracy-controlled evaluation framework with three complemen

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 LLM 校准评测中的一个基本偏差：不同模型准确率不同时，直接比较 ECE、Brier Score 等全局校准指标，会把“模型更少犯错”和“置信度更可信”混在一起。结果是校准排序可能反转，原本看起来校准更好的模型，在控制准确率后反而更差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在训练方法，而在模型评测协议。它提醒基座模型比较不能只看 raw calibration metric，尤其是在比较不同规模模型、reasoning/thinking 模型与普通模型时，准确率差异会系统性影响校准结论。这个问题会影响模型选择、风险评估、RL/SFT 后模型可靠性分析，以及 confidence elicitation 方法的比较。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 ACE，即 Accuracy-Controlled Evaluation。它不提出新的校准算法，而是提出更公平的比较方式。ACE 有三个视角：Instance-Aligned 只在两个模型结果相同的样本上比较置信度行为，控制最严格；Distribution-Aligned 匹配两个模型在正确/错误结果上的总体组成，保留更多样本，牺牲一部分实例级控制；Candidate-Aligned 用于共享候选答案空间的评估场景，让不同模型在同一批候选答案上判断置信度。三者共同目标是把“任务准确率”从“校准质量”里拆开。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 GPQA、LiveBench、MMLU、FreshQA、TriviaQA 等数据集，比较不同模型族、不同 confidence elicitation 方法，以及小模型/大模型、thinking/non-thinking 模型。一个关键结果是 raw ECE 差异与准确率差异高度相关：Figure 1 中模型对的准确率差与 raw ECE 差的 Spearman 相关为 ρ=-0.670，n=40，95% CI [-0.81, -0.45]，p<1e-5。控制准确率后相关性明显下降：Distribution-Aligned 为 ρ=-0.232 且不显著，Instance-Aligned 为 ρ=-0.174 且不显著；Candidate-Aligned 仍有一定相关，ρ=-0.454。实验还显示，许多 raw metric 下的校准优势在 ACE 下缩小，部分比较出现 ranking reversal。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看引言中的反例和 Figure 1，它说明为什么 raw ECE/BS 不能直接跨模型比较。然后看 ACE 三个视角的定义，关注它们各自控制了什么、损失了什么。实验部分建议只抓两类比较：规模比较和 thinking/non-thinking 比较。最值得带走的是评测设计原则：校准比较要先说明是否控制准确率，否则结论容易把能力差异误读成校准差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a confound in LLM calibration evaluation: when two models differ in accuracy, global metrics such as ECE and Brier Score do not isolate calibration quality. A stronger model can look better calibrated partly because it makes fewer mistakes. This can lead to ranking reversals after accuracy is controlled.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation methodology rather than pretraining itself. It is relevant for comparing base models, post-trained models, reasoning models, and different confidence elicitation schemes. The result cautions against treating raw calibration metrics as directly comparable across models with different task accuracies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is ACE, or Accuracy-Controlled Evaluation. It contains three complementary views. Instance-Aligned calibration compares models only on examples where they share the same correctness outcome, giving strict instance-level control. Distribution-Aligned calibration matches the aggregate mixture of correct and incorrect cases, keeping broader coverage while relaxing instance matching. Candidate-Aligned calibration applies the same idea when models evaluate a shared candidate answer pool. The method does not recalibrate models; it changes the comparison protocol so that calibration behavior is less entangled with accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study spans GPQA, LiveBench, MMLU, FreshQA, TriviaQA, multiple model families, and several confidence elicitation methods. A central result is that raw ECE differences are strongly correlated with accuracy differences across model pairs: Figure 1 reports Spearman ρ=-0.670 over n=40 dataset-level comparisons, with 95% CI [-0.81, -0.45] and p<1e-5. After accuracy control, the correlation is much weaker for Distribution-Aligned calibration, ρ=-0.232 and not significant, and for Instance-Aligned calibration, ρ=-0.174 and not significant. Candidate-Aligned calibration still shows a moderate residual relation, ρ=-0.454. The experiments also show that apparent calibration advantages often shrink, and ranking reversals appear in both scale-based and thinking-versus-non-thinking comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20–30 minutes. Start with the motivating example and Figure 1, since they make the accuracy confound concrete. Then read the definitions of the three ACE views and compare their assumptions. In the experiments, focus on the scale comparison and thinking/non-thinking comparison. The useful takeaway is a protocol-level one: calibration claims should state whether accuracy was controlled, otherwise model capability differences may be misread as calibration differences.

recommendation.zh: 读 ACE 三种对齐和 ranking reversal 结果；它会改变直接看 ECE/Brier 比模型校准的习惯。
recommendation.en: Read the three ACE alignments and the ranking-reversal results; it should weaken trust in raw ECE/Brier comparisons.

paper.title: Reported Confidence in LLMs Tracks Commitment More Than Correctness
paper.abstract: Confidence is an estimate of the probability that a chosen answer is correct. Verbal confidence reports are widely used as uncertainty measures in large language models, but whether they are best understood as estimates of correctness is unclear. We test this with a two-stage abstention paradigm from the neuroscience of perceptual decision making: a model first answers and reports its confidence, then decides whether to commit it to a user or abstain. Across four non-reasoning models, prompt fra

summary.core_problem: 论文检验一个常被默认接受的假设：LLM 的口头置信度是否真的是“答案正确概率”的估计。作者发现，口头置信度更像是模型是否愿意把答案交给用户的行为信号，即 commit-readiness，而不是可靠的 correctness signal。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：模型的自我报告信号不能简单当作内部知识可靠性的读数。log-prob 经过校准后更接近 answer evidence，而 verbal confidence 更贴近后续行为策略。这会影响拒答训练、校准训练、RLHF/RLAIF 中的可靠性奖励设计，也提醒研究者区分“知道自己对不对”和“是否准备承诺输出”这两类内部变量。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计了两阶段 abstention 范式。第一阶段让模型回答问题，并在不知道后续会被要求 commit/abstain 的情况下报告口头置信度。第二阶段再把第一阶段答案展示给模型，让模型选择提交答案或拒答。这样可以在同一批样本上比较两类预测关系：置信度预测真实正确性，还是预测后续提交行为。论文同时比较了 verbal confidence 和 calibrated token log-probabilities。进一步地，作者用残差分析去掉 verbal confidence 中与 calibrated log-prob 共享的部分，观察剩余信号是否仍然预测 commit 行为。机制分析部分在 Gemma 3/4 上研究 post-answer internal state，发现与 verbal confidence 相关的激活已经编码未来 abstention 决策，并且 commit/abstain 方向与 correctness 方向近似正交；在 Gemma 4 中沿 verbal-confidence-specific activation direction 做 steering，可以因果改变后续 abstention 行为。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖非推理模型和推理模型。非推理模型包括 Gemma 3 27B、Gemma 4 31B、GPT-4o、Qwen 3 235B no-think mode，任务包括 SimpleQA-derived multiple-choice 和 MMLU-Pro。推理模型包括 Gemini Flash 3 preview、Kimi K2 Think、GPT-oss-120B、Qwen 3 235B think mode，覆盖 SimpleQA、MMLU-Pro、SuperGPQA、HLE。主要结果是：verbal confidence 对后续 commit/abstain 的预测显著强于对答案正确性的预测；calibrated log-prob 的 abstention 预测能力与 correctness discrimination 更紧密耦合。残差 verbal confidence 仍然偏向预测 commitment，而与 correctness 的关系接近 chance。机制实验给出一致证据：commit-readiness representation 主要按后续 abstention 决策组织，而不是按答案对错组织。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看实验设计图和两阶段范式说明，因为这是区分 confidence-as-correctness 与 confidence-as-commitment 的关键。然后看 verbal confidence、calibrated log-prob、residual verbal confidence 三组结果的对比表或曲线。机制部分值得单独看 Gemma 3/4 的 activation-space 分析和 steering 实验，它们说明该现象不只是行为层面的 prompt artifact。若关注模型校准或拒答训练，可重点读讨论中关于 verbal confidence 作为 downstream reliability proxy 的限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether verbal confidence reports from LLMs should be interpreted as estimates of answer correctness. Its main finding is that verbal confidence tracks the model’s later willingness to commit to an answer more strongly than it tracks whether the answer is actually correct.
summary_en.importance: The result matters for calibration, abstention, and post-training signal design. A verbal confidence score is not interchangeable with calibrated log-probability. Calibrated log-probabilities behave more like answer-evidence signals, while verbal confidence behaves more like a behavior-facing readiness-to-commit signal. This distinction is relevant when using self-reported confidence as a reward feature, a verifier input, or a user-facing reliability proxy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a two-stage abstention paradigm. In stage one, the model answers a question and separately reports confidence, without being told that an abstention decision will follow. In stage two, the model sees its earlier answer and decides whether to commit it to a user or abstain. This setup allows the same stage-one confidence signal to be evaluated against two targets: objective correctness and later commit/abstain behavior. The paper compares verbal confidence with calibrated token log-probabilities, then residualizes verbal confidence against calibrated log-probabilities to isolate the component not shared with answer evidence. Mechanistic analyses on Gemma 3 and Gemma 4 examine post-answer internal states and find a representation that predicts future abstention before the abstention prompt is shown. The commitment and correctness components appear approximately orthogonal in activation space, and steering along a verbal-confidence-specific direction in Gemma 4 causally shifts abstention behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The behavioral experiments include four non-reasoning instruction-tuned models: Gemma 3 27B, Gemma 4 31B, GPT-4o, and Qwen 3 235B in no-think mode, evaluated on a SimpleQA-derived multiple-choice benchmark and MMLU-Pro. The reasoning-model experiments include Gemini Flash 3 preview, Kimi K2 Think, GPT-oss-120B, and Qwen 3 235B in think mode across SimpleQA, MMLU-Pro, SuperGPQA, and HLE. Across settings, verbal confidence predicts later commitment better than correctness. Calibrated log-probabilities show the opposite profile: their ability to predict abstention is tied to their ability to discriminate correct from incorrect answers. After removing the variance shared with calibrated log-probabilities, residual verbal confidence still predicts commitment behavior, while its relationship with correctness falls close to chance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Start with the two-stage abstention setup, since the separation between answer generation, confidence reporting, and later abstention is the core design choice. Then focus on the plots comparing verbal confidence, calibrated log-probability, and residual verbal confidence. The mechanistic section on Gemma 3/4 is the most useful part for readers interested in internal representations, especially the approximate orthogonality between commitment and correctness directions and the causal steering result.

recommendation.zh: 这会直接动摇“让模型口头报置信度就等于校准”的默认前提；做拒答、verifier 或 RL 奖励设计的人，至少把实验范式和残差分析复现一遍。
recommendation.en: This challenges the lazy assumption that verbal confidence is calibrated correctness; if you work on abstention, verifiers, or RL rewards, replicate the paradigm and the residual analysis before trusting confidence text.

paper.title: CalBrief: A Pilot Diagnostic Benchmark for Evidence-Calibrated Scientific Briefing with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as research assistants, yet it remains unclear whether they can calibrate research takeaways to the strength and scope of the supporting evidence. We study evidence-calibrated scientific briefing: given a bounded package of related papers, a system should generate package-level takeaways with evidence strength, scope boundaries, and missing-evidence caveats. We contribute a verified pilot benchmark of 16 heterogeneous scientific evidence package

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM 在给定一组相关论文时，能否生成与证据强度和适用范围相匹配的科学 briefing，而不是只会写流畅总结。
summary.importance: 这是一个小规模诊断型 benchmark。贡献在于把 scientific summarization 从“内容对不对”扩展到“证据强度是否校准、边界是否说清、缺失证据是否指出”，对研究助手类系统评测有一定价值，但对基座预训练的直接牵引较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 16 个异质 scientific evidence packages 和 96 条人工核验 takeaways，提出 CalBrief 这一可审计的 role/gap/strength 评测框架，并在公平 schema 下比较结构化组织、显式强度校准策略与直接生成基线。
summary.experiments: 评测对象包括 GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet、Gemini Flash 等闭源模型。摘要中的核心结论是：结构化组织有助于 role 和 gap reasoning，但显式 strength-calibration policy 反而系统性过于保守，表现低于 majority 和 direct-LLM baselines。数据规模仍然偏小，更像 pilot benchmark。
summary.authors_note: Sichuan University。更像研究助手/科学摘要评测方向的探索性工作，不属于基座模型训练主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can produce scientific briefings calibrated to evidence strength and scope, rather than merely fluent summaries.
summary_en.importance: This is a small diagnostic benchmark. Its contribution is to expand scientific summarization evaluation from correctness to calibration of evidence strength, scope boundaries, and missing-evidence caveats. The direct impact on pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build 16 heterogeneous scientific evidence packages and 96 human-verified takeaways, and introduce CalBrief, an auditable role/gap/strength evaluation framework. They compare structured organization, explicit strength-calibration policies, and direct-generation baselines under a fair schema.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is tested on GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet, and Gemini Flash. The main result in the abstract is that structured organization helps role and gap reasoning, but an explicit strength-calibration policy becomes systematically over-conservative and underperforms majority and direct-LLM baselines. The scale is still pilot-level.
summary_en.authors_note: Sichuan University. This is better viewed as an exploratory benchmark for research-assistant behavior than a foundation-model training paper.

recommendation.zh: 小 benchmark，不值得深读；只看结论即可：显式“保守校准”策略可能把模型推成过度保守，这对后训练 reward 设计算个弱提醒。
recommendation.en: This is a small benchmark and not worth a deep read; the only useful takeaway is that explicit calibration policies can over-regularize models into excessive conservatism.

institutions: research takeaways to the strength and scope of the supporting evidence
expanding the label space from binary {moderate, weak} to four-way
labels carry information that strict matching hides. Label-level strength
rently in tension, and should be evaluated separately for LLM research
LLM evaluation · Research briefing · Scientific summarization
of this failure to expanding the label space, finds that adding gap and scope

paper.title: PEBS: Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage for RLHF Reward-Model Calibration
paper.abstract: Reward models for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pool preferences across thousands of annotators and fit one global affine calibrator, collapsing raters with systematically different rating-scale offsets and slopes into a single average-rater fit that does not match any individual annotator. PEBS is a per-rater empirical-Bayes shrinkage estimator: it fits per-rater affine calibrators on a held-out slice of each annotator's ratings and applies Morris-James-Stein empirical-Bayes

summary.core_problem: 现有RLHF奖励模型采用全局仿射校准，忽略不同标注者的评分尺度偏移和斜率差异，导致校准结果与单个标注者不匹配
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需重训奖励模型的闭式后处理校准方案，解决RLHF中标注者异质性导致的RM校准偏差问题
summary.technical_approach: 提出PEBS（Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage）：对每个标注者的留出评分拟合独立仿射校准器，采用Morris-James-Stein经验贝叶斯方法向总体均值做闭式收缩，全程不改动基础奖励模型参数
summary.experiments: 在PRISM偏好数据集上，比全局 pooled 基线降低8.58%的用户内留出RMSE；在PluriHarms危害评分数据集（Qwen-2.5 base，同分布）上，RMSE降低9.66%

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RLHF reward models use a global affine calibrator across annotators, ignoring systematic differences in rater-specific rating scale offsets and slopes, resulting in calibration that does not match individual annotators
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a closed-form post-hoc calibration scheme without retraining the reward model, addressing RM calibration bias caused by annotator heterogeneity in RLHF
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PEBS (Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage): fits per-rater affine calibrators on held-out ratings from each annotator, then applies closed-form Morris-James-Stein empirical Bayes shrinkage toward the population mean, with no changes to the base reward model parameters
summary_en.experiments: Reduces within-user held-out RMSE by 8.58% over the pooled baseline on PRISM; achieves 9.66% RMSE reduction on PluriHarms harm ratings (Qwen-2.5 base, in-family) over the same baseline

recommendation.zh: RM校准的轻量实用改进，无需重训模型，做RLHF的同学可直接复用§3的闭式收缩公式验证内部标注偏差
recommendation.en: A lightweight practical improvement for RM calibration with no retraining required; RLHF practitioners can directly reuse the closed-form shrinkage formula in §3 to validate internal annotator bias

paper.title: Decision-Aligned Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification
paper.abstract: Uncertainty estimates in machine learning are typically evaluated using generic metrics such as the negative log-likelihood and expected calibration error, yet good performance on such metrics does not necessarily imply high utility in downstream decisions. We introduce decision-alignment, a criterion that reveals which evaluation metrics meaningfully align with downstream utilities. Applying this framework, we show that many widely used uncertainty metrics are either misaligned with common deci

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究不确定性估计的评价指标是否真的服务于下游决策，而不是只在 NLL、ECE 等通用 surrogate metric 上表现好。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座研究的关联是间接但清楚的。预训练和 posttrain 里越来越依赖 reward model、verifier、judge、selective generation、拒答策略和风险控制，这些模块都需要可靠的不确定性评价。该工作给出的信息是：校准误差或似然分数并不必然对应决策收益；如果评价指标隐含的下游 utility prior 不合理，模型排序会误导方法选择。
summary.technical_approach: 核心概念是 decision-alignment。给定一族下游 utility 函数 U_theta，如果存在一个关于 theta 的 prior pi，以及对固定标签集 y 的严格单调函数 h_y，使得某个 metric 对预测的排序与在 pi 下的期望下游 utility 排序一致，则该 metric 与这族决策对齐。这个定义把 metric 分析转化为一个隐含决策信念问题：一个指标到底在假设什么样的下游任务分布。文中进一步给出必要且充分的等价条件：decision-aligned metric 等价于对相应 utility family 的严格保序和保 ties。基于这个框架，作者分析常见 UQ 指标，指出一些指标要么无法对应一致的决策信念，要么对应病态的 prior。随后提出 prior-weighted utility metrics，这是一类 proper scoring rules，用显式 prior 加权下游 utility，从而让不确定性评价直接贴近决策价值。
summary.experiments: 实验包含分类和回归设置，并加入现实案例。主要结论是，prior-weighted utility metrics 与真实下游 utility 的一致性更稳定；NLL、ECE 等常用指标在若干设置下会给出与下游收益不一致的模型排序。可用全文片段没有列出具体 benchmark 名称、数值表格或提升幅度，因此重点应放在评价框架和反例分析，而不是单个实验数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。优先看第 3 节 decision-alignment 的定义和 Proposition 3.4，因为这是整套论证的核心。然后看作者如何把 NLL、ECE 等指标解释为隐含 utility prior，尤其是病态 prior 或无法对齐的例子。第 4 节的 prior-weighted utility metrics 值得仔细看，适合迁移到 reward model calibration、LLM judge calibration、verifier confidence evaluation。实验部分可快速浏览，主要确认不同指标与真实 downstream utility 的排序相关性。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether standard uncertainty-evaluation metrics actually support downstream decisions, rather than merely optimizing generic surrogates such as negative log-likelihood or expected calibration error.
summary_en.importance: The connection to foundation-model research is indirect but useful. Modern LLM pipelines rely on reward models, verifiers, judges, selective prediction, abstention policies, and risk-aware routing. All of these depend on uncertainty estimates. The main lesson is that calibration or likelihood metrics can rank models differently from the utility that matters in deployment. If a metric encodes an unsuitable implicit prior over downstream decisions, it can push method development in the wrong direction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central notion is decision-alignment. For a family of downstream utilities U_theta, a metric is decision-aligned if there exists a prior over theta and a strictly increasing transformation, for each fixed label set, such that the metric ranks predictions exactly as expected downstream utility under that prior. This turns metric analysis into an analysis of implicit decision beliefs. The work proves an equivalence: decision-alignment is the same as strict order preservation and tie preservation with respect to the corresponding utility family. The framework is then used to analyze common uncertainty metrics, showing that some either fail to correspond to any coherent decision belief or encode pathological priors. The proposed alternative is prior-weighted utility metrics, a class of proper scoring rules that evaluates probabilistic predictions through an explicit prior over downstream utilities.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section covers classification and regression benchmarks plus real-world case studies. The reported pattern is that prior-weighted utility metrics align more consistently with actual downstream utilities, while common metrics such as NLL and ECE can produce model rankings that do not match decision value. The provided content does not include full benchmark names, tables, or numerical effect sizes, so the reliable takeaway is the evaluation criterion and the failure modes of standard metrics rather than a specific numeric improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Read the definition of decision-alignment and Proposition 3.4 carefully, since they define the metric-utility connection. Then inspect the examples analyzing NLL, ECE, and other common UQ metrics through their implicit utility priors. The section on prior-weighted utility metrics is the most transferable part for LLM work, especially reward-model calibration, verifier confidence, and judge reliability. The experiments can be read mainly for evidence that metric rankings and downstream utility rankings diverge under standard metrics.

recommendation.zh: 对做 RLHF/RL 奖励模型、verifier、主动数据筛选的预训练研究员有启发，读 §3-§4 看指标如何系统性错位于真实效用即可。
recommendation.en: Useful for pretrain researchers working on reward-model calibration, verifiers, and active data selection. Focus on §3–§4 to see how standard UQ metrics can systematically diverge from real decision utility.

paper.title: When are likely answers right? On Sequence Probability and Correctness in LLMs
paper.abstract: Many decoding methods for large language models can be understood as shifting probability mass toward outputs that are more likely under the model, either locally at the token level or globally at the sequence level. Therefore, their success depends on a fundamental question: when does sequence probability, that is, the conditional probability of a continuation given a prompt, actually align with correctness? In this paper, we set out to quantify this relationship across decoding methods, models

summary.core_problem: 现有多数LLM解码方法都倾向于将概率质量向模型认为更高概率的序列偏移，但其有效性依赖一个未被系统验证的前提：序列的条件概率与答案正确性是否对齐，以及在什么条件下对齐。
summary.importance: 澄清了序列概率与正确性的关联边界，对解码方法设计、无验证器自训练/自蒸馏（如用高概率样本做自一致性训练）的适用范围给出了实证依据，也为预训练阶段校准模型概率-正确性关联提供了观测参考。
summary.technical_approach: 将解码方法分为局部token级（低温采样、top-k/top-p截断等）和全局序列级（best-of-N、power采样等）两类，统一从「偏移概率质量至高概率区域」的视角建模；在四个层级量化概率-正确性相关性：跨解码方法、同方法内跨超参数、数据集内跨prompt-answer对、同prompt下跨重复生成样本。实验覆盖8种解码方法、14个模型（Qwen2.5/Qwen3/Olmo3系列）、6个基准数据集。
summary.experiments: 核心发现包括：1）数据集内跨样本的概率-正确性相关性稳定存在，主要由数据集和模型家族决定，与解码方法无关，说明模型本身具备区分正确/错误样本对的能力；2）通过调整解码方法或其超参数提升序列概率，无法稳定带来正确率提升；3）同prompt下的多样本内部相关性弱且不稳定，仅在模型本身任务准确率较高时才存在有效信号，限制了概率加权聚合（如自一致性）的可靠性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章的四层相关性分析实验结果与对应结论，第2章的解码方法统一视角建模可快速浏览。预计阅读时间12-18分钟，附录的变分目标推导可按需选读。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing LLM decoding methods shift probability mass toward higher-probability sequences under the model, but their effectiveness relies on an unsystematically validated premise: whether and under what conditions the conditional probability of a sequence aligns with its factual correctness.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the boundary of alignment between sequence probability and correctness. Provides empirical evidence for the applicable scope of decoding method design and verifier-free self-training/self-distillation (e.g., self-consistency training with high-probability samples), and offers observational references for calibrating probability-correctness alignment during LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes decoding methods into local token-level (low-temperature sampling, top-k/top-p truncation, etc.) and global sequence-level (best-of-N, power sampling, etc.) types, and unifies them under the framework of "shifting probability mass to high-probability regions". Quantifies probability-correctness correlation at four levels: across decoding methods, across hyperparameters within the same method, across prompt-answer pairs within a dataset, and across repeated generations for the same prompt. Experiments cover 8 decoding methods, 14 models (Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Olmo3 families), and 6 benchmark datasets.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings: 1) Within-dataset cross-sample probability-correctness correlation is stable, determined primarily by dataset and model family rather than decoding method, indicating models inherently have the ability to distinguish correct from incorrect prompt-answer pairs; 2) Increasing sequence probability by adjusting decoding methods or their hyperparameters does not reliably improve accuracy; 3) Within-sample correlation across multiple generations of the same prompt is weak and unstable, with valid signals only appearing when the model already has high task accuracy, limiting the reliability of probability-weighted aggregation methods like self-consistency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (four-level correlation analysis results and conclusions). Skim Section 2's unified modeling of decoding methods if familiar with the area. Estimated reading time: 12-18 minutes; optional reading of variational objective derivation in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验分层和相关性矩阵即可；它修正了“概率更高就该解码出来”的常见直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the stratified experiments and correlation tables; the useful bit is the clean split between likelihood as a predictor and likelihood as a decoding intervention.

paper.title: Don't Go Breaking My LLM: The Impact of Pruning Attention Layers on Explanation Faithfulness and Confidence Calibration
paper.abstract: Pruning Large Language Models (LLMs) reduces memory and inference costs by removing parts of the network, producing smaller models that retain most of their accuracy. As attention layers are the most resource-intensive parts of LLMs, pruning them is a promising compression strategy. Prior work shows that up to 33% of attention layers can be pruned with minimal accuracy loss. Nevertheless, the impact of attention pruning on model interpretability, specifically faithfulness and confidence calibrat

summary.core_problem: 现有注意力层剪枝研究仅关注精度保留，未评估其对模型解释忠实度与置信校准的影响。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次系统量化注意力剪枝对解释性与校准的副作用，填补模型压缩策略的评估维度盲区。
summary.technical_approach: 选取5个LLM与8个数据集，控制不同注意力层剪枝比例（最高33%），对比剪枝前后的精度、解释忠实度、置信校准三类指标的变化。
summary.experiments: 覆盖5个LLM、8个数据集，发现剪枝后精度稳定时，解释忠实度与置信校准仍可能显著波动甚至退化，存在精度与解释性/校准的错位。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing attention layer pruning work only focuses on accuracy retention, without evaluating its impact on explanation faithfulness and confidence calibration.
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis contribution, first systematic quantification of attention pruning's side effects on interpretability and calibration, filling the evaluation gap for model compression strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Select 5 LLMs and 8 datasets, control different attention layer pruning ratios (up to 33%), and compare changes in accuracy, explanation faithfulness, and confidence calibration before and after pruning.
summary_en.experiments: Across 5 LLMs and 8 datasets, it finds that even when accuracy remains stable after pruning, explanation faithfulness and confidence calibration may still fluctuate significantly or degrade, showing a misalignment between accuracy and interpretability/calibration.

recommendation.zh: 剪枝的精度保留不代表解释性/校准完好，做压缩策略评估时可参考其指标设计，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Attention pruning's accuracy retention does not guarantee faithfulness or calibration; reference its metric design for compression evaluation, no deep read needed.

paper.title: How Reliable Is Your Jailbreak Judge? Calibration and Adversarial Robustness of Automated ASR Scoring
paper.abstract: Almost every paper on LLM jailbreaks and prompt injection reports an attack-success rate (ASR), and that number is assigned not by people but by an automated judge: either a safety classifier trained for the task, or a general chat model prompted to grade. The judge is rarely checked. We check it. Using 596 human-labeled completions from the HarmBench classifier validation set, we compare the two judge families against human majority votes and then attack them. The two families fail in opposite

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM jailbreak 论文中常用的自动 ASR judge 是否经过校准，以及它们是否容易被无害包装文本攻击。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法与 judge 可靠性分析。它直接质疑安全评测里最常用的 attack success rate 计算方式，对后训练安全实验、red teaming 结论可复现性、自动评测协议都有影响。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 HarmBench classifier validation set 中 596 条人工标注 completion，将专用 safety classifier 与 prompted LLM-as-judge 两类自动裁判和人类多数投票对齐比较；随后构造不改变 harmful text 的 benign framing、前置 refusal sentence 等包装攻击，测试 judge 的鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 专用分类器表现为过度标记，precision 为 0.835、recall 为 0.974；三个 LLM-as-judge 保持较高 precision，约 0.81 到 0.94，但 recall 波动很大，只有 0.06 到 0.65。同一批响应会因 judge 选择得到不同 ASR。无害 wrapper 可使每个 LLM judge 在 57% 到 100% 的样本上翻转判定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the automated judges used to compute jailbreak attack success rate are calibrated and robust to adversarial presentation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. It challenges a core measurement practice in jailbreak and prompt-injection work, with implications for safety post-training, red teaming, and the reproducibility of ASR claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses 596 human-labeled completions from the HarmBench classifier validation set. It compares dedicated safety classifiers and prompted LLM judges against human majority labels, then attacks the judges with benign wrappers and prepended refusal-like framing that leave the harmful content intact.
summary_en.experiments: The dedicated classifier over-flags, with precision 0.835 and recall 0.974. Three LLM judges maintain high precision, from 0.81 to 0.94, but show unstable recall from 0.06 to 0.65. The same completions can yield different ASR depending on the judge. Benign wrappers flip LLM-judge decisions between 57% and 100% of the time.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测里 ASR judge 的地基被敲了一下；只看校准表和 wrapper attack 结果就够。
recommendation.en: This pokes at the foundation of ASR-based safety evaluation; read the calibration table and wrapper-attack results.

paper.title: CALIBER: Calibrating Confidence Before and After Reasoning in Language Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models are increasingly asked not only to answer difficult questions, but also to estimate their likelihood of success. Existing methods typically elicit confidence only once: either before thinking or after answering. We argue that confidence in reasoning models is state-dependent: before thinking, confidence should estimate the chance of the model correctly solving the prompt, while after thinking it should predict whether the realized answer is likely to be correct. This di

summary.core_problem: 解决推理模型在“思考前”和“作答后”置信度估计混为一谈，导致校准目标错配的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练与评估交界处的工作，贡献是把置信度校准拆成两个信息状态下的不同任务。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提醒我们，模型内部状态变化后，监督目标也应随之变化，不能把所有 uncertainty 都压成一个标量。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CALIBER，分别在看到 prompt 后、以及完成 reasoning/answer 后各 elicitation 一次 confidence。前者用 prompt-level success 作为监督目标，估计“这道题我能不能做对”；后者用 answer-level correctness 作为监督目标，估计“我刚给出的这个答案对不对”。核心不是新架构，而是统一协议下的信息状态匹配监督。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 CALIBER 相比只在单一时刻估计置信度的方法，将 Expected Calibration Error 降低 52.5%。任务对象是 reasoning language models，但摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称和 baseline 列表；从描述看，比较对象主要是只在思考前或只在作答后做一次 confidence elicitation 的现有做法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a target-mismatch problem in confidence estimation for reasoning models: confidence before thinking and confidence after answering are treated as the same task when they should not be.
summary_en.importance: This sits at the boundary of post-training and evaluation. Its main contribution is to split calibration into two tasks tied to two information states. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that supervision targets should track the model's state; uncertainty should not always be collapsed into a single scalar prediction.
summary_en.technical_approach: CALIBER elicits confidence twice: once after seeing the prompt and once after producing reasoning/answer. The first is supervised with prompt-level success, estimating whether the model can solve the problem; the second is supervised with answer-level correctness, estimating whether the realized answer is correct. The novelty is not architectural but in state-matched supervision under a unified protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 52.5% reduction in Expected Calibration Error relative to single-shot confidence baselines. The target setting is reasoning language models, but the abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or the exact baseline suite; the comparison appears to be against methods that elicit confidence only before or only after reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 更像后训练校准小修正，不会改变 pretrain prior；如果你在做 verifier、selective generation 或 RL 置信度奖励，只看“双时刻、双监督目标”这个设定就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a neat post-training calibration fix, not a pretraining prior shift; if you work on verifiers, selective generation, or confidence-based rewards, the only thing to take is the two-state, two-target setup.

paper.title: Grad Detect: Gradient-Based Hallucination Detection in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks, yet they remain prone to generating hallucinations. Detecting these hallucinations is critical for deploying LLMs reliably in high-stakes applications. We present Grad Detect, a gradient-based approach for predicting hallucinations by analyzing layer-wise gradient patterns from a single forward-backward pass during inference. Our method shows that the internal gradient structure of a model carries rich i

summary.core_problem: 能否在单次 forward-backward 中利用逐层梯度信号在推理时检测 LLM 幻觉与 abstention 需求，而不依赖采样或置信度。
summary.importance: 提出一种基于内部表示（梯度）而非输出置信度的幻觉检测器，并做了跨 11 个模型、4 个架构族的层消融；对理解模型最后几层的校准信号有价值，但偏部署侧而非预训练核心。
summary.technical_approach: Grad Detect 在给定 prompt 和生成答案后做一次反向传播，提取 layer-wise gradient pattern 作为特征，训练轻量判别器判断输出是否正确/是否应该拒答；原创点在于直接使用梯度内部结构而非 logprob/self-consistency。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 11 个模型、4 个架构族的 QA benchmarks，在 hallucination detection 和 abstention prediction 上优于 confidence-based 和 sampling-based 基线；层消融显示最后 5 层集中了 >97% 的判别信息；摘要未给出具体模型名列表和绝对指标幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Can layer-wise gradient patterns from a single forward-backward pass at inference time detect LLM hallucinations and abstention needs, without relying on confidence scores or multiple samples?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an internal-representation (gradient-based) hallucination detector rather than output-logprob or sampling-based ones, with ablations across 11 models from four architectural families; useful as a probe into calibration signals in late layers, though deployment-oriented rather than core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Given a prompt and generated answer, Grad Detect runs one backward pass and extracts per-layer gradient statistics as features to train a lightweight binary classifier for correctness/abstention; the key novelty is using internal gradient structure instead of logprob or self-consistency.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multiple Q&A benchmarks across 11 models and four architectural families, outperforming confidence-based and sampling-based baselines on both hallucination detection and abstention prediction; layer ablation shows the last five layers carry >97% of discriminative signal; abstract does not list specific models or absolute gains.

recommendation.zh: 信号有趣但属推理时探测，对预训练是弱启发；只看 layer ablation 和 Fig 4 哪几层贡献即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting inference-time probe with weak pretraining relevance; just read the layer-ablation section to see which layers carry calibration signal.

paper.title: Jury Duty: Calibration and Orientation Failures in MLLM-as-a-Judge Under Cultural Ambiguity
paper.abstract: MLLM-as-a-Judge is conventionally validated by agreement with human annotations, but this metric is undefined when the human pool is culturally heterogeneous. We introduce VOIR DIRE, a multimodal benchmark of 626 culturally paired image--prompt artifacts spanning U.S. and mainland Chinese contexts across food, fashion, and architecture, with annotator pools that are within-pool reliable (a = 0.86/0.74) but cross-pool divergent on evaluation (Q1 r = -0.12). Across six MLLMs, the bias decomposes i

summary.core_problem: MLLM-as-a-Judge的常规验证方式是测量模型输出与人类标注的一致性，但这类验证不区分标注群体的文化背景。在涉及偏好、审美、价值判断的歧义场景下，不同文化群体的评价存在系统性分歧，现有流程会默认将单一群体的偏好作为「标准答案」，既无法识别裁判模型内化的文化偏向，也会将这类偏向伪装成客观评分，通过RLAIF、评测榜单传导为下一代模型的训练信号偏差。
summary.importance: MLLM/LLM-as-a-Judge的输出已经成为RLAIF训练信号、自动评测榜单的核心组成部分，裁判端的系统偏差会沿着训练闭环逐轮放大，而非孤立的评测噪声。多模态场景下视觉符号承载的文化属性比纯文本更隐蔽，此前对模型对齐偏向的讨论多集中在生成端，这项工作明确了评判端偏差的传导路径，以及偏差的两个可分离来源，提示仅靠单一人标注池的一致性无法验证裁判模型的可靠性，对评测协议设计、对齐训练信号质量控制有直接参考。
summary.technical_approach: VOIR DIRE多模态评测基准包含626组中美文化配对的图像-评价提示题项，覆盖饮食、时尚、建筑与符号三个领域。每对题项使用同一图像生成模型、完全匹配的参数（构图、光线、比例、风格）生成，仅文化符号存在差异，排除图像质量、美学特征等混淆变量对评分的影响。标注由两个独立的、文化背景同质的标注组完成（美国、中国大陆各5名双文化流利标注者），组内标注一致性较高（克朗巴赫α=0.86/0.74），但组间对评价类问题的判断相关性极低（Pearson r=-0.12），证明题项确实存在稳定的文化分歧而非标注噪声。基于该基准，MLLM裁判的偏差被分解为两类可分离的失效模式：一是校准失效，打分集中在正向区间，压缩量表的动态范围，极少使用低分；二是定向失效，模型默认偏向某一文化的评价规范，无法对异文化场景给出符合对应群体预期的判断。
summary.experiments: 在6个主流MLLM上的测试得到三个核心结论：（1）两个文化组对图像事实内容的识别一致性很高（76%~85%的题项内容判断一致），但在好坏、适当性这类评价维度上分歧极大；（2）所有被测模型都同时存在两类失效：打分集中在正向区间的校准问题，以及与模型开发所属地区对应的稳定文化定向偏向；（3）添加文化人设提示、使用目标文化的ICL示例仅能小幅减弱定向偏向，无法消除跨文化评价分歧，说明这类偏向是模型在预训练和对齐阶段内化到权重中的，而非提示可以调整的表层应答习惯。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分关于裁判偏差沿训练闭环传导的逻辑、两类失效模式的拆分，以及提示无法消除定向偏向的核心结论。可跳过标注流程细节、统计鲁棒性检验部分，除非直接从事裁判模型开发或评测设计工作。预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional validation of MLLM-as-a-Judge systems measures agreement between model outputs and human annotations, but does not account for the cultural composition of the annotator pool. On preference-sensitive tasks involving aesthetics, appropriateness, or value judgments, evaluative judgments diverge systematically across cultural groups. Existing validation pipelines treat a single group's preferences as ground truth, failing to detect cultural biases internalized in judge models — biases that are embedded in scalar scores, then propagated into RLAIF training signals and leaderboard ground truth for subsequent model training cycles.
summary_en.importance: Outputs from LLM/MLLM judges now form a core component of RLAIF training signals and automated evaluation pipelines, so systematic bias in judges does not remain isolated to evaluation, but amplifies across successive training loops. Multimodal settings carry particular risk, as visual symbols encode dense, often unrecognized cultural meaning that is invisible to text-only bias audits. Prior work on alignment bias has largely focused on model generation; this work identifies a separate bias pathway through evaluation, and decomposes judge bias into two separable components, demonstrating that single-pool human agreement is insufficient to validate judge reliability. The findings have direct implications for evaluation protocol design and alignment training signal quality control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The VOIR DIRE multimodal benchmark contains 626 culturally paired image-prompt items spanning U.S. and mainland Chinese contexts across food, fashion, architecture, and cultural symbols. Each concept pair is generated with the same image model under matched parameters (composition, lighting, aspect ratio, style), so only cultural cues differ across pairs, eliminating confounds from image quality or aesthetic signatures that could independently drive rating differences. Annotations are collected from two independent, culturally homogeneous annotator groups (five U.S.-based, five mainland China-based biculturally fluent annotators), with verified high within-group agreement (Cronbach's α = 0.86 / 0.74) but near-zero cross-group correlation on evaluative judgments (Pearson r = -0.12), confirming stable cultural divergence rather than annotation noise. Using this benchmark, MLLM judge bias is decomposed into two separate failure modes: calibration failure, where scores are compressed into the positive range of the scale with minimal use of low scores, reducing dynamic range; and orientation failure, where the model systematically defaults to the evaluative norms of one cultural group, failing to match the judgments of other groups on culturally specific items.
summary_en.experiments: Tests across six mainstream MLLMs yield three core results: (1) Annotators from both cultural groups show high agreement on factual content depicted in images (76–85% consensus on content identification), but near-zero agreement on evaluative judgments of quality or appropriateness; (2) All tested models exhibit both failure modes: compressed positive score distributions, and stable orientation bias aligned with the regional origin of the model's development; (3) Cultural persona prompting and in-context examples drawn from the target cultural group reduce but do not eliminate orientation bias, indicating these biases are encoded in model weights during pretraining and alignment, rather than being superficial response tendencies adjustable via prompting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core argument and findings. Focus on the causal pathway linking judge bias to propagated training signal in RLAIF and benchmarks, the two-component decomposition of judge failure, and the finding that prompting cannot resolve orientation bias. Skip granular annotation protocol details and statistical robustness checks unless working directly on judge model development or evaluation design. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 裁判评测方法学的重要警告：文化异质时“和人一致”这个指标本身无效，关注§4的偏差分解方法和Fig.6里ICL反而加重偏差的部分。
recommendation.en: A critical methodological warning for LLM-as-a-judge: under cultural heterogeneity human-agreement metric itself is invalid; focus on §4 bias decomposition and Fig.6 where ICL worsens bias.

paper.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Black-Box Uncertainty Estimation Methods for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, their outputs often remain unreliable and may contain hallucinations, making uncertainty estimation (UE) essential for building trustworthy LLMs. In practice, many mainstream LLMs are only accessible through restricted APIs, where internal signals such as logits and hidden states are unavailable, making black-box UE especially important. However, existing work on black-box UE for LLMs remains fragm

summary.core_problem: 在只能通过 API 访问、拿不到 logits/hidden states 的“黑盒”条件下，如何为 LLM 的单次回答生成可用的置信度/不确定性分数，并且系统性回答：哪些黑盒 UE（uncertainty estimation）方法在不同任务形态（开放式 vs 选择题式）下真正有效、代价如何、在区分能力与校准性上各自短板是什么。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接改 recipe 的论文，但对“训练—对齐—部署”闭环里风险控制很关键：1）给出黑盒 UE 的可复用评测框架与方法谱系，能直接指导线上系统的拒答/回退/多采样策略；2）把 UE 的有效信息源拆成“答案空间结构”“采样分布的语义聚合”“候选集先验”等，可反过来启发白盒 UE 或训练时的显式校准目标（例如把语义熵/一致性信号蒸馏进模型）；3）对 MLLM 的 UE 也有迁移意义，因为很多 MLLM 最终仍由文本解码头产出答案与推理链，黑盒信号在多模态场景更常见。
summary.technical_approach:
全文核心是两件事：
1）分类学（taxonomy）：按主要可观测信号与建模策略把黑盒 UE 分为五类——verbalization-based（让模型口头报分/报概率/报置信区间等）、sampling-based（多次采样后用分布形态或语义聚类度量不确定性，如 semantic entropy 一类）、explanation-based（利用 CoT/解释的一致性、可验证性或自我反思信号）、multi-agent（多代理辩论/投票/协作校准）、hybrid（组合多种信号）。这个分类的价值在于把“UE 其实在用什么信息”说清楚，而不是按论文名字堆列表。
2）统一评测框架：把不同方法输出统一映射为 confidence score C(x,y)∈[0,1]，同时从 discrimination（排序/区分正确与错误）与 calibration（数值可解释性，p(correct|score=q)=q）两条线评估。并且显式区分开放式 QA 与封闭式（有候选集）QA：开放式更依赖语义层面的答案分布结构；封闭式可以直接利用候选空间做归一化与对比。
从文中给出的经验结论看，开放式 QA 上更占优的是：a）基于答案空间推理（answer-space reasoning）的做法；b）“采样 + 语义聚合 + 再 verbalize/归一”的组合；c）把互补信号融合的 hybrid。封闭式 QA 上，显式利用候选集结构的方法优势更稳定，因为它把不确定性问题从“开放生成的语义等价类”降维成“有限集合上的选择与校准”。
summary.experiments: 论文宣称在统一框架下对 24 种代表性黑盒 UE 方法做系统比较，覆盖 4 个模型与 4 种数据集设置，并同时覆盖开放式与封闭式 QA；指标维度包含区分能力与校准性两类。给出的正文片段未包含具体模型名称、数据集名称、以及关键数值（如 AUROC/AUPRC、ECE/Brier、不同方法的相对提升、推理成本曲线等），因此无法在不臆测的前提下复述具体数字。若要抓住实验部分的信息量，建议重点核对：不同任务形态下“最优方法族”是否稳定、成本—收益是否呈现拐点、以及是否存在‘高区分但严重失校准’或相反的典型失败模式。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Problem Formulation（把 U(x) 与 C(x,y) 统一到 confidence score 的处理，以及 discrimination vs calibration 的定义），这是后面所有对比能成立的前提。
- 再看 Table 1（方法清单 + 计算成本 + 是否原生输出[0,1]可校准分数 + 适用开放/封闭 QA），用它快速定位你关心的线上可用方法。
- 重点读 taxonomy 章节：每一类方法到底在利用什么可观测信号、哪些信号在开放式/封闭式分别更有效。
- 最后扫实验结论段落：把“开放式靠语义聚合/答案空间结构、封闭式靠候选集结构”的经验规律记下来，后续做白盒 UE 或训练时蒸馏/校准目标时可直接复用这个分解。

summary_en.core_problem: How to estimate per-answer uncertainty/confidence for LLMs under a strict black-box setting (API-only, no logits/hidden states), and—more importantly—how to compare a broad set of black-box UQ methods in a unified way across open-ended generation and closed-set QA, along both discrimination and calibration axes.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-recipe paper, but it matters for the pretrain→post-train→deployment loop: (1) it provides a reusable evaluation harness and a clearer map of what black-box UQ methods actually exploit; (2) the empirical separation between “open-ended semantic answer space” vs “known candidate space” is a practical design rule for production risk control (abstention, fallback, multi-sampling); (3) the decomposition of useful signals (semantic aggregation, answer-space structure, candidate-set priors, hybrid fusion) can be distilled into white-box objectives or training-time calibration targets later.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper does two things.
1) A taxonomy of black-box UQ for LLMs into five families based on observable signals: verbalization-based (ask the model to report confidence/probabilities), sampling-based (multi-sample then measure distributional/semantic dispersion such as semantic entropy), explanation-based (use CoT/explanations and their consistency or self-critique signals), multi-agent (debate/vote/collaborative calibration), and hybrid (combine multiple signals).
2) A unified evaluation protocol: normalize heterogeneous outputs into a confidence score C(x,y) in [0,1], then evaluate both ranking/discrimination and numerical calibration. A key methodological choice is to explicitly separate open-ended QA from closed-ended QA; the former needs semantic equivalence handling and benefits from semantic aggregation over samples, while the latter can directly leverage the known candidate set for normalization and sharper comparisons.
summary_en.experiments: They report a systematic comparison of 24 representative black-box UQ methods over 4 models and 4 dataset settings, covering both open-ended and closed-ended QA, and measuring both discrimination and calibration. The provided excerpt does not include the concrete model/dataset names or the headline numbers (e.g., AUROC/ECE/Brier, cost–quality trade-offs), so specific quantitative results cannot be reproduced here without guessing. The main empirical takeaway stated in-text is: open-ended QA tends to favor answer-space reasoning, sampling + semantic aggregation, and hybrid complementary signals; closed-ended QA favors methods that explicitly exploit the candidate space.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the problem formulation first: how they unify uncertainty vs confidence into C(x,y), and how they define discrimination vs calibration.
- Use Table 1 to shortlist methods by inference cost and whether they natively output calibrated [0,1] scores.
- Focus on the taxonomy section to understand what information each family extracts and why it matches open-ended vs closed-ended settings.
- Then scan the empirical insights section to capture the task-dependent “which signal works” rules you can reuse in deployment or in future white-box training objectives.

recommendation.zh: 做黑盒UE的“对照组大全”，结论不惊艳但能省你大量重复实验；只看方法分类+主结果表，顺便挑两三个稳健基线进自家评测。
recommendation.en: A practical black-box UE bake-off: not a new theory, but it saves weeks of duplicated baselines—read the taxonomy and the main result tables to pick robust defaults.

paper.title: Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR): Function-Preserving SVD Compression for LLMs
paper.abstract: We present Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR), an SVD-based LLM compression framework that guides each weight matrix's low-rank approximation with a backward-signal influence metric. Starting from the activation-aware optimum of SVD-LLM(W), AIR runs a single closed-form alternating least squares (ALS) sweep that integrates influence element-wise under a monotone-descent guarantee. AIR is layer-local and composes orthogonally with end-to-end methods: alone it exceeds ACIP, and AIR+LoRA o

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但长期存在的压缩问题：SVD 类低秩压缩很便宜，也天然适合 Transformer 线性层，但标准 SVD 只最小化权重矩阵的重构误差，SVD-LLM(W) 这类方法虽然进一步引入了 activation-aware profiling，能保住前向表示，却仍然不知道“哪些权重误差真的会影响最终预测”。已有 backward-signal 方法要么效果不如 activation-only 基线，要么需要端到端优化，代价高、工程复杂。AIR 要解决的核心点，是在保持 layer-local、闭式、低成本的前提下，把逐元素的后向影响信号真正整合进低秩近似，而不是只把 backward signal 当作一个粗糙权重或额外启发式。
summary.importance: 对大模型研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在于它把“函数保持型压缩”往前推进了一步：一方面说明 activation-aware 已经不够，压缩时需要区分哪些残差会传到输出端；另一方面也说明 backward information 并不一定需要 critic-like 的全局优化或复杂蒸馏，局部闭式更新也能吃到这部分收益。对基座研究员更有启发的是方法论：很多压缩、剪枝、量化问题里，前向统计和后向影响往往都重要，关键不是有没有 backward signal，而是如何把它嵌入一个可解、稳定、可扩展的目标。AIR 给出的答案是把 influence 作为逐元素加权残差引入，再用 rank-wise ALS 近似求解。这种设计对后续做 low-rank adaptation、结构化压缩、甚至训练期正则化都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三层。第一层是沿用 SVD-LLM(W) 的 activation profiling。作者先用校准集收集隐藏状态 X，通过 profiling 矩阵 S 把原始权重 W 映射到 latent space，得到 W' = WS 一类的变换，使得原本的输出误差 ||WX - W_k X||_F^2 可以转成对 profiled weight 的近似问题。这样 activation-aware 目标仍然保留了 SVD 的可处理性。

第二层是 backward influence 的构造。作者不限定唯一信号，而是接受一类逐元素影响分数 I，包括 Weight×Gradient、对角 Fisher、以及 LRP/AttnLRP。默认实现用 AttnLRP，理由是它不依赖梯度回传规则，且对近零激活更稳。具体做法是对每个样本得到逐层 relevance 矩阵，再在校准集上累加绝对值，并做层内均值归一化。这里一个重要实验结论是：在 AIR 的更新机制下，具体选哪种“合理的” backward signal 差别不大，真正决定效果的是整合机制本身。

第三层是核心创新：把 influence 以逐元素加权的方式并入 activation-aware 目标。作者定义混合损失，大意是对 profiled residual 的每个元素乘上 sqrt(1 + delta * I_ij)。这个 all-ones anchor 很关键，它避免低影响位置被“打折”到几乎不管，只是在高影响位置额外提高误差代价。问题在于，带逐元素权重的低秩逼近一般没有标准 SVD 闭式解。AIR 的处理是：先用 SVD(W', k) 作为初始化，再做一次 rank-wise 的 alternating least squares sweep，从后往前更新每个 rank-1 分量 (sigma_r, u_r, v_r)。作者给出了闭式更新，并证明单步是 monotone descent。逆序更新的动机也很明确：先修正尾部成分，尽量少扰动前几个主奇异方向。

从设计取舍看，AIR 明显是在 ACIP 和 SVD-LLM 之间找平衡。它不像 ACIP 那样做端到端优化，也不需要 LoRA 式额外训练才能起效；但又比纯 activation-aware 多了一层函数敏感性。作者还展示了 AIR 与 LoRA 微调是正交可叠加的，说明它更像一个高质量初始化或局部压缩器，而不是完整替代 end-to-end reconstruction。
summary.experiments:
实验主线比较清楚。核心结果是在 LLaMA-7B 上，不同保留率下 AIR 相比 SVD-LLM(W) 的 WikiText-2 perplexity 明显更低：在 60% / 40% / 20% 参数保留率时，困惑度分别降低约 18% / 33% / 45%。这说明压缩越激进，逐元素 influence weighting 的收益越大，因为误差预算更紧，残差该放在哪些位置变得更重要。

数据效率也是一个亮点。作者报告 AIR 在大致相同质量下只需要约 10% 的 calibration data，就能匹配 SVD-LLM(W) 的效果，也就是校准数据需求下降约 90%。这点很实用，因为很多后训练压缩流程真正卡的不是算法，而是拿不到足够代表性的校准集。

泛化方面，方法不只在 LLaMA-7B 上有效，也覆盖了 LLaMA、Mistral、Vicuna 等家族。说明它并不依赖某个特定模型的奇异值谱形态。消融里有几个值得注意的结论：第一，合理的 backward signal 之间差异很小，LRP-epsilon、Weight×Gradient、Fisher 在 AIR 框架下几乎等价；第二，若换成无信息或弱信息的 influence baseline，性能会明显掉下去，说明 backward signal 仍然要有基本质量；第三，all-ones anchor 和 delta 的设置会影响稳定性，纯 influence-only 的加权不如 activation + influence 的混合目标稳。

系统指标上，作者给了部署层面的数字：在 40GB A100 上，60% 参数保留率可带来约 64% 的 peak memory 和 53% 的 per-token latency，相当于参数节省确实转化成了实际推理收益，而不是只停留在理论压缩率。另一个重要结果是 AIR + LoRA 在各压缩率下都优于 ACIP，说明 layer-local 压缩和轻量端到端补偿是互补的。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议抓三部分。

第一，看方法部分里 hybrid objective 的定义，以及为什么 element-wise weighted low-rank approximation 不能直接用标准 SVD 解。这里是整篇文章最核心的数学动机。若只看结论，很容易误以为 AIR 只是“给 SVD 加了个 backward 权重”，但真正有效的是后面的 rank-wise ALS 近似求解。

第二，看 ALS 更新的推导和更新顺序。重点不是把公式逐行抄下来，而是理解两个设计：为什么从 SVD-LLM(W) 的 activation-aware optimum 出发；为什么按 rank 从后往前扫一遍就够。这里能看出作者在效果、复杂度、稳定性之间的平衡。

第三，看消融表和 Figure 3 一类分析图。建议重点确认三件事：不同 influence signal 是否真的接近等效；all-ones anchor 是否必要；校准数据量缩小时 AIR 的退化曲线是否更缓。若只想快速判断是否值得复现，这几张图比主表更有信息量。

这篇适合 30 到 45 分钟泛读。若你做的是压缩、低秩适配、训练后结构化优化，可以再花时间看附录里关于 LRP 和 weighted objective 的推导。

summary_en.core_problem: AIR addresses a specific weakness of SVD-based LLM compression. Plain SVD is cheap and structurally aligned with transformer linear layers, but it only minimizes matrix reconstruction error. Activation-aware variants such as SVD-LLM(W) preserve forward activations better, yet they still do not distinguish which approximation errors actually matter for the final prediction. Prior backward-signal methods either underperform activation-only baselines or rely on expensive end-to-end optimization. The paper asks whether one can inject backward functional importance into low-rank compression while keeping the procedure layer-local, closed-form, and lightweight.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a new pretraining method, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it sharpens the notion of function-preserving compression. The paper shows that forward statistics alone are not enough once compression becomes aggressive; one also needs a notion of output-side sensitivity. More importantly, it shows that backward information does not have to be consumed through full reconstruction training or global fine-tuning. A carefully designed local objective plus a simple solver can already recover much of the benefit. That design pattern is useful beyond post-training compression: it is relevant to pruning, low-rank adaptation, structured regularization, and any setting where forward usage and backward influence need to be balanced.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components.

First, AIR inherits the activation-aware profiling step from SVD-LLM(W). Hidden states X are collected on a calibration set, and a profiling matrix S is used to transform the weight matrix into a latent space, so the activation reconstruction objective becomes a low-rank approximation problem on the profiled weight W'. This preserves the computational convenience of SVD while making the objective more aligned with actual layer inputs.

Second, AIR constructs an element-wise influence matrix I from backward information. The framework is agnostic to the exact signal: Weight×Gradient, diagonal Fisher, and LRP-style relevance are all allowed. The default choice is AttnLRP, motivated by gradient-free propagation rules and better robustness around near-zero activations. Per-sample relevance maps are accumulated in absolute value over the calibration set and normalized to unit mean per layer. One of the paper’s useful findings is that, once AIR’s integration mechanism is used, the exact choice among reasonable backward signals matters much less than how the signal is incorporated.
