Third, AIR defines a hybrid activation-and-influence-aware objective. Each element of the profiled residual is weighted by a factor of the form sqrt(1 + delta * I_ij). The additive all-ones anchor is important: low-influence entries are not discounted away; high-influence entries simply become more expensive to approximate poorly. This leads to an element-wise weighted low-rank approximation problem, which in general has no standard SVD closed-form solution. AIR therefore starts from the activation-aware optimum SVD(W', k), then performs a single rank-wise alternating least squares sweep. Each rank-1 component is updated in closed form, and the updates are ordered from the tail components toward the leading ones to avoid disturbing the dominant singular directions too much. The paper also provides a monotone-descent guarantee for this sweep.

Conceptually, AIR sits between SVD-LLM and ACIP. It is much cheaper and more local than end-to-end reconstruction methods, but it is more function-aware than pure activation-based compression. The paper further shows that AIR composes well with LoRA-style end-to-end correction, which makes it look like a strong local compressor or initializer rather than a replacement for all downstream reconstruction.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is on LLaMA-7B. At 60%, 40%, and 20% parameter retention, AIR reduces WikiText-2 perplexity relative to SVD-LLM(W) by about 18%, 33%, and 45%, respectively. The gain grows as compression becomes more aggressive, which is exactly where better allocation of approximation error should matter most.

Calibration efficiency is another strong point. AIR reportedly matches the quality of SVD-LLM(W) with roughly 90% less calibration data. That matters in practice because many post-training compression pipelines are bottlenecked by representative calibration data rather than by solver cost.

The method is also tested across multiple model families, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Vicuna, suggesting that the effect is not tied to one specific singular-value profile. The ablations are informative. Reasonable backward signals such as LRP-epsilon, Weight×Gradient, and Fisher become nearly equivalent under AIR’s update rule, while weak or uninformative signals perform worse. The additive anchor and the influence strength delta also matter: a pure influence-only weighting is less stable than the hybrid activation-plus-influence objective.

On system metrics, the paper reports that at 60% retention on a 40GB A100, the compressed model achieves about 64% peak-memory usage and 53% per-token latency relative to the original, indicating that parameter savings translate into actual inference gains. AIR combined with LoRA also outperforms ACIP across retention rates, supporting the claim that local compression and lightweight end-to-end correction are complementary.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts.

First, read the definition of the hybrid objective and the discussion of why element-wise weighted low-rank approximation cannot be solved by standard SVD. That is the real mathematical motivation of the paper. Without it, AIR can look like a minor reweighting trick, which would miss the point.

Second, read the derivation of the rank-wise ALS updates and the reverse update order. The key questions are why the method starts from the activation-aware optimum and why a single backward sweep over rank components is enough. This is where the paper’s balance between quality, cost, and stability becomes clear.

Third, inspect the ablations and analysis figures, especially the ones testing signal choice, the all-ones anchor, and reduced calibration data. Those sections are more informative than the headline table if the goal is to decide whether the method is robust enough to reproduce.

This is a 30–45 minute skim for someone already familiar with SVD-LLM and post-training compression. If your work touches low-rank adaptation or function-preserving model surgery, the appendix on LRP and the weighted objective is worth extra time.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和校准数据消融即可；它不会改变压缩范式，但 influence 信号可能是低秩剪裁的好特征。
recommendation.en: Read the method and calibration-data ablation; it will not change the compression paradigm, but influence is a useful feature for low-rank pruning.

paper.title: Quantifying Aleatoric Uncertainty of In-Context Learning for Robust Measure of LLM Prediction Confidence
paper.abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) allows LLMs to adapt to new tasks from a few demonstrations, but its reliability remains a concern: predictions are highly sensitive to both prompt design and the model's ability to understand the context, obscuring whether failures arise from data properties or model limitations. Uncertainty decomposition-separating aleatoric from epistemic sources-is particularly crucial in this setting, yet existing methods, designed for standard generation tasks, fail to capture the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图在 ICL 场景下，把 LLM 预测不确定性分解为 aleatoric 与 epistemic 两部分，并给出更稳健的置信度估计。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值主要在分析层：ICL 的失败到底来自任务本身含糊，还是模型没有学会上下文中的概念，这个区分对 eval 和 post-train 都有意义。贡献类型是机制化不确定性建模，而不是训练方法突破。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 self-function vectors，结合 ICL 的 mechanistic interpretability 视角与 Bayesian 表述，用内部表示去刻画模型在上下文中形成的潜在概念，再据此直接估计 aleatoric uncertainty。方法刻意绕开对输入扰动、采样扰动或解码技巧的依赖，试图从表征层面做不确定性分解。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模和 benchmark 名称，但提到现有 benchmark 不适配，因此作者应构建了适合 ICL 不确定性评估的实验设置，并与标准生成任务上的置信度方法比较。若正文有校准误差、OOD 稳健性和 prompt 敏感性分析，值得快速扫一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper aims to decompose uncertainty in in-context learning into aleatoric and epistemic parts, and to provide a more robust confidence estimate for LLM predictions.
summary_en.importance: Its value to a pretraining researcher is mainly analytical: distinguishing whether ICL failures come from intrinsic task ambiguity or from the model failing to infer the latent concept from context is useful for evaluation and post-training. The contribution is mechanistic uncertainty modeling, not a training breakthrough.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce self-function vectors, combining a Bayesian view with mechanistic interpretability of ICL. The idea is to use internal representations to model the latent concept learned from in-context demonstrations, and then directly estimate aleatoric uncertainty. The method intentionally avoids brittle input perturbations or decoding manipulations and instead works at the representation level.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or benchmark names, but it notes that existing benchmarks are inadequate, so the paper likely builds an ICL-specific uncertainty evaluation setup and compares against standard confidence methods for generation. If the paper includes calibration, OOD robustness, and prompt-sensitivity analyses, it is worth a quick scan.

recommendation.zh: 偏分析，不会直接改你的 pretrain recipe；但如果你在做 ICL 机制或置信度评估，先看 self-function vectors 的定义和校准实验，别被 Bayesian 包装词吓到。
recommendation.en: Analytical rather than recipe-changing; if you care about ICL mechanisms or confidence, read the self-function vector definition and calibration results, not the Bayesian wrapping.

paper.title: From Drift to Coherence: Stabilizing Beliefs in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often hypothesized to perform implicit Bayesian inference, yet a key coherence condition, the martingale property of predictive beliefs, has been shown to fail in controlled synthetic in-context learning settings. We revisit this question in a more typical usage regime: generic multiple-choice question answering. Exploiting the discrete answer space, we compute exact predictive distributions and study belief dynamics induced by autoregressive answer resampling. W

summary.core_problem: LLM 的“信念/概率”在重复作答同一问题时是否满足贝叶斯预测序列应有的相干性条件（martingale / c.i.d.），以及如果不满足，能否通过推理时重采样或训练目标把信念过程稳定下来，从而得到更可校准的不确定性估计。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接改动不多，但对“训练目标如何塑造概率相干性与校准”有启发：它把 Falck 等人在玩具 ICL 任务里发现的 martingale 违背，搬到更贴近真实使用的多选 QA，并提出一种可操作的诊断协议（PPR）与一个可用于微调的相干性损失。若该损失在更广泛任务上成立，它可能成为一种面向校准/不确定性的后训练正则项，也可能反向提示预训练阶段的目标缺口（AR 训练并不保证序列预测的时间一致性）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设置是把输出空间限制为离散的多选集合 A，从而可以“精确”计算模型对每个选项的概率（直接读 logits），避免只靠采样估计分布。
提出 Prompted Predictive Resampling（PPR）：让模型在同一上下文里连续生成一串对同一问题的答案（不是独立采样），并在每一步都计算对 A 的预测分布，观察这个分布序列是否满足 martingale（直观上：在看到自己先前的回答后，后验预测的期望应保持一致）。
经验现象：早期步骤存在 belief drift（违反 martingale），但重采样足够多步后分布会自稳定并收敛到一个“相干”的预测过程。
在此基础上给出两条工程化路径：
1）prompt 技巧加速稳定（细节需看方法章节：通常会是要求模型显式输出分布/理由、或加入一致性约束的提示）。
2）用一个 enforcing c.i.d. 的损失做微调，把“需要多步重采样才能稳定”的过程摊销到一次前向里（amortization），目标是改善校准而不损伤准确率。
整体更像：诊断工具 + 推理时程序（多步自条件化）+ 可选的后训练正则。
summary.experiments:
全文片段未给出具体基准名称、模型规模、以及校准指标（ECE/Brier/NLL 等）的数值结果，因此无法安全复述提升幅度。引言层面可确认的结论是：
- 在标准多选 QA 上，PPR 观察到短期漂移、长期稳定；
- 稳定后（通过足够 resampling 或通过 amortized 微调），不确定性校准变好且准确率不下降。
阅读时需要重点核对：稳定需要多少步（成本是否可接受）、对不同温度/采样策略是否鲁棒、以及“稳定”是否只是趋向更尖锐/更保守的分布而非真正更校准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1）先看他们如何形式化 martingale/c.i.d. 在多选离散空间的可检验条件，以及具体统计量怎么计算；这是方法可信度的关键。
2）看 PPR 的提示模板与生成协议：是否把先前答案回填到上下文、是否要求解释、以及如何避免提示诱导。
3）直接看校准实验：用的指标、分桶方式、以及 accuracy–calibration 的 trade-off 图。
4）如果考虑复现/迁移：优先关注他们的 amortization 微调损失定义与训练细节（batch 里如何构造“同一问题的多步序列”）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether LLM predictive beliefs are dynamically coherent in the Bayesian sense—specifically satisfying the martingale / c.i.d. condition—when the model repeatedly answers the same multiple-choice question, and whether inference-time resampling or a training loss can stabilize the belief process to improve uncertainty calibration.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but it is relevant to how training objectives shape probabilistic coherence and calibration. It operationalizes martingale-violation diagnostics beyond synthetic ICL tasks by moving to standard multiple-choice QA where the full predictive distribution over a finite answer set can be computed exactly from logits. The proposed c.i.d.-enforcing finetuning loss could serve as a post-training regularizer for calibration, and it also highlights a potential gap: standard AR training does not guarantee time-consistent predictive beliefs under self-conditioning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper restricts outputs to a discrete answer set A (multiple-choice), enabling exact computation of predictive probabilities from logits rather than sampling-based density estimates.
It introduces Prompted Predictive Resampling (PPR): the model generates a sequence of answers to the same question within a single prompted interaction; at each step, the predictive distribution over A is recomputed, yielding a belief trajectory. Martingale/c.i.d. coherence is then tested on this trajectory.
Empirical pattern: early steps show belief drift (martingale violations), but after enough resampling steps the belief process self-stabilizes and converges to a coherent regime.
Two practical add-ons are proposed: (i) a prompting trick to accelerate stabilization; (ii) an amortized finetuning strategy with a loss derived from enforcing c.i.d., aiming to get the stabilized distribution in fewer (ideally one) steps, improving calibration without hurting accuracy.
Overall: a diagnostic protocol + an inference-time procedure + an optional finetuning regularizer.
summary_en.experiments:
The excerpt does not include concrete benchmark names, model sizes, or numerical calibration results (e.g., ECE/Brier/NLL), so exact deltas cannot be reported safely. High-level claims from the introduction are:
- On standard multiple-choice QA, PPR reveals short-run drift but long-run stabilization.
- Once stabilized (via sufficient resampling or amortized finetuning), predictive distributions are better calibrated without sacrificing accuracy.
Key checks when reading: how many resampling steps are needed (cost), robustness to temperature/sampling choices, and whether “stabilization” corresponds to genuine calibration improvements rather than simply becoming sharper/more conservative.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the formalization of martingale/c.i.d. in the finite-answer setting and the exact test statistic—this determines whether the diagnosis is meaningful.
2) Inspect the PPR prompting/generation protocol (how previous answers are fed back, whether rationales are requested, and how prompt-induced artifacts are controlled).
3) Go straight to calibration results: metrics, binning, and accuracy–calibration trade-off plots.
4) If you want to reuse the idea, focus on the amortization loss definition and training construction (how multi-step sequences per question are formed in batches).

recommendation.zh: 只看 PPR 诊断和 self-consistency loss；它不改预训练 recipe，但能校准对采样信念稳定性的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the PPR diagnostic and the self-consistency loss; it does not change pretraining recipes, but it sharpens priors about belief stability under sampling.

paper.title: From Uncertain Judgments to Calibrated Rankings: Conformal Elo Estimation for LLM Evaluation
paper.abstract: Evaluating new large language models typically requires costly human annotation campaigns at scale. LLM-as-a-judge offers a cheaper alternative, but judge scores carry systematic errors - such as position bias, self-preference, or intransitivity - that can strongly miscalibrate the resulting rankings. We quantify the resulting judge-human disagreement at two complementary levels. At the local level, we estimate per-battle uncertainty from the judge's own score differences by propagating calibrat

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM-as-a-judge 评测中 judge-human 不一致导致模型 Elo 排名失准的问题，尤其是位置偏置、自偏好和非传递性带来的系统误差。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法改进。它不是提出新 benchmark，而是把不确定性校准和 conformal prediction 引入 LMArena 式 pairwise ranking，使自动评测结果带有可解释的误差条和覆盖保证。对依赖 judge 做模型选择、post-train checkpoint 选择和公开榜单解释的团队有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两层。局部层面不把 judge 输出硬转成胜负标签，而是从 judge 分数差估计校准后的胜率，再把概率胜负输入 Bradley-Terry/Elo 估计。全局层面用 split conformal prediction 拟合 LLM-derived Elo 与 human-derived Elo 的残差，为新模型排名给出分布无关的预测区间。
summary.experiments: 在 LMArena 上做 held-out model 评估，覆盖 55 个保留模型。核心结果是仅用 judge score difference 的概率传播，就能把 LLM-derived rating 与 human-derived rating 的平均误差降到 17.9 Elo MAE。论文还报告 conformal interval 能对 judge-human Elo gap 给出边际覆盖保证，但摘要未给出具体 interval 宽度和 judge 模型细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses miscalibrated LLM Elo rankings caused by judge-human disagreement, including position bias, self-preference, and intransitive judgments.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method contribution rather than a new benchmark. It adds calibrated uncertainty and conformal prediction to LMArena-style pairwise ranking, making automatic model evaluation less brittle and giving error bars with coverage guarantees. It is directly relevant to teams using judges for model selection or checkpoint comparison.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method operates at two levels. Locally, it converts judge score differences into calibrated win probabilities and feeds probabilistic outcomes into the Bradley-Terry/Elo estimator instead of hard labels. Globally, it applies split conformal prediction to the residual gap between LLM-derived and human-derived Elo ratings, producing distribution-free prediction intervals for model ratings.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use LMArena with 55 held-out models. Propagating calibrated win probabilities from judge score differences reduces the mean absolute error between LLM-derived and human-derived ratings to 17.9 Elo. The abstract also claims marginal coverage for conformal intervals, though it does not expose the interval widths or judge details.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim：只看概率 Bradley-Terry 和 conformal residual 设计，能改进内部 judge 榜单的误差表达。
recommendation.en: Skim it for the probabilistic Bradley-Terry and conformal residual setup; it is useful for putting honest error bars on internal judge leaderboards.

paper.title: Multiagent Protocols with Aggregated Confidence Signals
paper.abstract: Confidence is used for reliability, oversight, and a range of downstream decision tasks in Natural Language Processing (NLP), yet no existing method produces or evaluates a confidence for the output of a multiagent system. Prior work uses confidence within multiagent debate (MAD) to weight messages, trigger debate, or calibrate individual agents, but it never aggregates these into a single confidence for the system itself. We introduce three protocols that produce a final answer along with a sin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：多智能体系统给出最终答案时，如何把各个 agent 的置信信号聚合成一个可比较、可校准、可用于决策的系统级置信度。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 agent 可靠性方法，而不是基座模型训练。它的价值在于把单 agent 置信度扩展到 multi-agent setting，并给出可验证的聚合协议与校准流程；对做 post-train、judge、self-verification 或多 agent 推理系统的人有参考意义，但对预训练本身的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三种协议：先把不同模型产生的原始 confidence 做变换，使其在跨模型间可比；再用 soft voting 或一种称为 Bayesian fusion 的概率融合方式，得到单一系统级 confidence。文中还比较了两类置信估计器，包括 sequence probability 和 self-report confidence，并分析它们在多 agent 聚合中的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 实验以 AUARC 评估置信度判别力，以 F1 评估答案正确性。结果显示，聚合后的 confidence 比最佳单 agent 或标准 multi-agent debate baseline 更有区分度，同时 F1 基本保持稳定，并在更模糊的任务上弥补了 MAD 带来的性能损失。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体任务集细节，因此目前更像一篇系统协议层面的经验论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to produce a single, calibrated system-level confidence score for a multi-agent system, rather than leaving confidence at the individual-agent level.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent reliability paper, not a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its value is in extending confidence estimation from single-agent outputs to multi-agent protocols with explicit aggregation and calibration; useful for people working on post-training, judges, self-verification, or multi-agent reasoning systems, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose three protocols: first transform raw confidence signals so they become comparable across models, then aggregate them via soft voting or a probability-fusion method they call Bayesian fusion. They also compare two confidence estimators, including sequence probability and self-reported confidence, and analyze how they behave under multi-agent aggregation.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate discriminative quality with AUARC and answer quality with F1. Aggregated confidence is reported to be more discriminative than the best single agent and standard debate baselines, while keeping F1 roughly stable and recovering some losses that MAD incurs on ambiguous tasks. The abstract does not provide model scales, dataset sizes, or detailed task setup, so this currently reads as a protocol-level empirical paper.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深；若你在做 verifier、self-eval 或多 agent 置信校准，只看聚合协议与 AUARC 结果，别把它误当成能力提升论文。
recommendation.en: Not very pretrain-relevant; read only the aggregation protocol and AUARC tables if you care about verifier-style confidence calibration, not capability gains.

paper.title: Calibration Drift Under Reasoning: How Chain-of-Thought Budgets Induce Overconfidence in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to express calibrated uncertainty is important for safe deployment. Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely used to improve accuracy and reliability, but its effect on calibration is not fully understood. We show that this picture is incomplete: in some settings, increasing the reasoning budget beyond a task-specific threshold can cause models to become systematically overconfident, assigning high confidence to incorrect answers. We call this phenom

summary.core_problem: CoT 通常被用来提升准确率，但更长的推理预算是否会改善不确定性校准并不清楚；作者研究 reasoning budget 增加时校准误差为何会先降后升。
summary.importance: 这是一个机制与可靠性分析工作。价值在于提醒研究者：更长推理链不等于更好校准，accuracy gain 和 calibration gain 可能脱钩，尤其对安全部署和 verifier 设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Calibration Drift Under Reasoning（CDUR）现象，并给出一个基于自回归生成的 Hypothesis Lock-In 模型：随着推理变长，模型先通过额外推理纠正部分错误，但超过任务相关阈值后，可能围绕早期错误假设生成越来越自洽的错误解释，导致对错误答案的置信度上升。分析重点是把 ECE 视为 reasoning budget B 的非单调函数。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 Llama-3.1-8B 等模型上做理论与实证分析，但未给出完整任务集、数据规模和提升/退化幅度。核心结果是 ECE(B) 呈非单调变化：预算较小时校准改善，超过阈值后出现系统性过度自信。由于模型和评测范围看起来不大，这更像一个值得跟进复现的现象，而不是已被大规模验证的定律。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-of-thought is often used to improve accuracy, but it is unclear whether longer reasoning budgets also improve uncertainty calibration; the paper studies why calibration error can first decrease and then increase as reasoning gets longer.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and reliability analysis paper. Its value is the warning that longer reasoning does not imply better calibration: accuracy gains and calibration gains can decouple, which matters for safe deployment and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Calibration Drift Under Reasoning (CDUR) and proposes a Hypothesis Lock-In model grounded in autoregressive generation. As reasoning length increases, the model may initially correct errors through additional deliberation, but beyond a task-dependent threshold it can elaborate around an early wrong hypothesis, producing increasingly self-consistent but incorrect explanations and higher confidence on wrong answers. The analysis treats ECE as a non-monotonic function of reasoning budget B.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions theoretical and empirical study on models including Llama-3.1-8B, but does not provide full task coverage, dataset scale, or effect sizes. The main reported result is a non-monotonic ECE(B): calibration improves at small budgets and then degrades into systematic overconfidence beyond a threshold. Given the limited evidence visible in the abstract, this looks more like a phenomenon worth reproducing than a settled law.

recommendation.zh: 现象层面值得记住：长 CoT 可能把错答案讲得更笃定；但证据规模看起来偏小，先把它当 failure mode 假说，读图和定义即可。
recommendation.en: The phenomenon is worth remembering: long CoT can make wrong answers sound more certain; but the evidence looks small-scale, so treat it as a failure-mode hypothesis and just read the definition and plots.

institutions: SG Balekundri Institute of Technology, Belagavi

paper.title: Calibrating Overconfidence Without Sacrificing Confidence: Probe-Conditioned Head Intervention for LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models often express high confidence in answers that are wrong. Standard calibration remedies typically act globally or at the score level, reducing unwarranted confidence but also risking erosion of warranted confidence on correct answers. We introduce Probe-Conditioned Head Intervention (PCHI), an inference-time method that uses a frozen probe to detect likely wrong-but-confident responses and conditionally rescales downstream attention-head outputs during confidence generation.

summary.core_problem: LLM 常对错误答案表达高置信度（过度自信），现有校准方法会同时损害正确答案的合理置信度。
summary.importance: 提出推理时校准方法，在减少过度自信的同时最小化对正确置信度的损害。贡献类型：方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: Probe-Conditioned Head Intervention (PCHI)：用 frozen probe 检测可能的错误-高置信回答，在置信度生成过程中条件性地重缩放下游注意力头输出。
summary.experiments: Qwen3-4B-Instruct 和 Gemma3-4B 上测试 OpenMathInstruct。Readout-token PCHI 转换 82.2% 错误-高置信回答，联合干预将 ECE 从 21.9% 降到 9.2%，仅损害 5.1% 正确回答。
summary.authors_note: Ke Li 等，机构信息无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs often express high confidence in wrong answers (overconfidence); existing calibration remedies risk eroding warranted confidence on correct answers.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an inference-time calibration method that reduces overconfidence while minimizing damage to correct confidence. Contribution type: methodological innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Probe-Conditioned Head Intervention (PCHI): uses a frozen probe to detect likely wrong-confident responses, then conditionally rescales downstream attention-head outputs during confidence generation.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Gemma3-4B on OpenMathInstruct. Readout-token PCHI converts 82.2% of wrong-yes readouts; joint intervention reduces ECE from 21.9% to 9.2%, damaging only 5.1% of correct-yes readouts.
summary_en.authors_note: Ke Li et al.; institutional affiliation not confirmed.

recommendation.zh: 推理时 head intervention 做 calibration 的思路有一定启发性，但仅在 4B 模型上验证且是 inference-time trick——读 §3 的 PCHI 机制就够了。
recommendation.en: Inference-time head intervention for calibration is somewhat interesting, but only validated on 4B models and remains an inference-time trick; just read §3 for the PCHI mechanism.

paper.title: Code Is More Than Text: Uncertainty Estimation for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as code generators, where silently wrong programs pose real safety and reliability risks. Reliable uncertainty estimation (UE) is essential for selective prediction, human-in-the-loop review, and downstream agentic decisions. Yet most existing code UE methods are inherited from natural language (NL) generation and ignore properties that make code distinct. We argue that code differs from NL in three ways: a single wrong token can break an en

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注代码生成中的不确定性估计：自然语言生成里常用的置信度方法往往不能识别“看起来流畅但程序是错的”这种代码特有风险。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法改进加分析框架。它不是在做更强代码模型，而是提出代码场景下更合适的 uncertainty decomposition，对 selective prediction、人审触发和 agent 决策有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者认为代码不同于自然语言，至少有三类独特不确定性：词法层面的 token fragility、算法意图与具体实现之间的 intent-code gap，以及程序可执行带来的 functional uncertainty。基于此，他们构造三条互补的 UE 轴：lexical uncertainty 用 Top-K token entropy，algorithmic uncertainty 用 pseudo-code consistency，functional uncertainty 用 behavioral consistency；最后将三者做 ensemble 作为代码生成的置信度估计。
summary.experiments: 实验在 5 个代码 LLM 上进行，和从自然语言生成迁移来的 UE baseline 比较。摘要报告最强 NL-derived baseline 的平均 AUROC 为 0.696，而三轴集成达到 0.776，提升 8.1 个点。摘要没有给出具体模型名、数据集规模和各轴单独贡献，但从结果看，执行语义相关信号比纯 token-level 置信度更有效。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies uncertainty estimation for code generation, arguing that confidence methods inherited from natural language generation miss code-specific failure modes where outputs look fluent but are functionally wrong.
summary_en.importance: This is a methodological refinement plus an analysis framework. It does not advance base-model pretraining directly, but it offers a more code-appropriate decomposition of uncertainty that matters for selective prediction, human review, and agentic code execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors identify three code-specific uncertainty sources: token fragility, the gap between algorithmic intent and concrete implementation, and executability. They instantiate these as three complementary uncertainty axes: lexical uncertainty via Top-K token entropy, algorithmic uncertainty via pseudo-code consistency, and functional uncertainty via behavioral consistency, then ensemble them for final uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover five code LLMs and compare against uncertainty-estimation baselines adapted from natural language generation. The abstract reports an average AUROC gain from 0.696 for the strongest NL-derived baseline to 0.776 for the proposed three-axis ensemble, a +8.1 point improvement. The abstract does not specify the full model list or dataset details.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，但它提醒一件常被忽略的事：代码 LM 的错误不是 token-level calibration 能解释完的；只看三种 uncertainty 分解和 AUROC 表即可。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but it usefully reminds you that code-LM failures are not captured by token-level calibration alone; the three-way uncertainty decomposition and the AUROC table are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: UnpredictaBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Distributional Randomness in LLMs
paper.abstract: We introduce UnpredictaBench, an evaluation that tests the ability of large language models (LLMs) to capture true underlying distributions. As LLMs are increasingly used as substitutes for other entities (e.g., for humans in economic simulations), the tendency of many models to collapse towards a single plausible answer means a failure to capture the unpredictability of real systems. Recent work on improving output diversity is insufficient for this setting: simulation requires samples that are

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否真的学会按目标分布采样，而不是只生成多个“看起来合理”的答案。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测工作。它把“输出多样性”与“分布校准”明确区分开，提出 UnpredictaBench 和 KS@N 指标，适合检验模型在模拟、随机过程建模、代理人替身等场景中的分布拟合能力。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 448 个采样任务，覆盖标准统计分布、随机程序诱导分布、以及自然语言描述的随机过程。核心不是让模型给出单个正确答案，而是多次采样后比较经验分布与目标分布的接近程度。为此提出 KS@N 作为通用评测指标，衡量黑箱采样质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型列表和提升幅度，但说明该 benchmark 用于测试模型是否会坍缩到单一 plausible answer，而不是忠实反映底层随机性。实验重点应是比较不同模型和解码策略在 448 个问题上的分布拟合表现，而非传统 accuracy。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 University of British Columbia。Peter West 在 LLM 评测与生成质量分析方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can sample from target distributions rather than merely produce multiple plausible-looking outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution. It cleanly separates output diversity from distributional calibration, introducing UnpredictaBench and the KS@N metric for testing whether models capture stochastic processes faithfully.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 448 sampling problems spanning canonical statistical distributions, stochastic-program-induced distributions, and natural-language descriptions of random processes. The key idea is to assess the empirical distribution of repeated model samples against the target distribution, using KS@N as a black-box sampling metric.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list exact model suites or gains, but the benchmark is designed to expose mode collapse toward a single plausible answer instead of faithful uncertainty modeling. The main experiments likely compare models and decoding schemes on distribution matching rather than standard accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from the University of British Columbia. Peter West is known for work on LLM evaluation and generation analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 核心，但它把“多样”与“校准采样”分开了；做 synthetic data、simulator 或 self-play 的人应只看任务设计和 KS@N 定义。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it usefully separates diversity from calibrated sampling; if you build synthetic data, simulators, or self-play loops, read only the task design and KS@N metric.

paper.title: Large Language Models Are Overconfident in Their Own Responses
paper.abstract: Prior work has shown that instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) are less well calibrated than their base pre-trained counterparts. However, little is known about the frequently used chat template's effect on the calibration of conversational LLMs. In this work, we investigate the mechanisms driving this miscalibration by decoupling the effects of the post-training algorithm and the chat format. We find that, while instruction tuning fundamentally harms calibration, the chat template agg

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 instruction tuning 和 chat template 各自如何影响 LLM 的置信度校准，并进一步验证模型是否会对“自己刚生成的答案”表现出额外过度自信。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 pretrain 与 posttrain 接口。已有观察是 base model 通常比 instruction-tuned model 更接近校准，但原因不清楚。这篇工作把训练算法影响和交互格式影响拆开，说明校准退化主要来自 instruction tuning，chat template 会进一步放大问题。这个结论对 posttrain 数据、偏好优化目标、assistant 角色建模都有参考价值：模型学到的不只是更高任务准确率，也学到了一种“应该确信地回答”的行为先验。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文比较同一模型家族的 base 与 instruct 版本，并对 instruct 模型分别使用普通 prompt 和 chat template。这样可以把三个因素拆开：预训练模型本身、instruction tuning 后的模型参数变化、chat 格式引入的角色与话语结构。校准评估使用多项选择任务中答案 token 的概率，并计算 ECE 和 Brier score。进一步地，作者用显式置信度询问来排除“只是 logit 读数方式导致”的解释。核心机制假设是 ownership bias：当答案被表示为 assistant 自己的输出时，模型比面对用户提供的同一答案更自信。缓解方法也很直接：在询问置信度时，把待评估答案重新包装成用户输入，而不是 assistant 自己的回答。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 组开源模型的 base/instruct 配对：Llama 3.1 8B/70B、Qwen3 4B/30B、Gemma 3 4B/27B。论文提到使用 3 个 benchmark 和 3 种置信度 elicitation 方法；提供内容中详细展示的是 MMLU 上的 logit-based calibration。结果显示，instruction tuning 平均提升准确率 3.7%，但 ECE 增加 13.1%，Brier score 增加 6.5%。在 instruct 模型上加入 chat template 只带来约 1.1% 的准确率提升，却额外增加 2.74% ECE 和 1.5% Brier score。base 到 instruct+chat 的总 ECE 增幅约为 15.8%。这些数字说明准确率收益和校准退化同时出现，且主要退化来自 post-training，而不是单纯来自 chat 格式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三个部分：第一，模型设置中 base、instruct-without-chat、instruct-with-chat 的对照设计，这是这篇论文最有用的因果拆分；第二，Table 1 中准确率、ECE、Brier 的变化，能直接看到 posttrain 与 chat template 的相对贡献；第三，ownership bias 的验证和把答案包装为用户输入的 mitigation。对预训练研究员来说，不必纠结具体 benchmark 分数，更值得关注的是 posttrain 如何改变模型的置信度先验，以及这种行为是否能通过训练数据格式、assistant role loss weighting 或 calibration-aware posttrain 来修正。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how much of LLM miscalibration comes from instruction tuning itself, how much comes from the chat template, and whether models become especially overconfident when judging answers framed as their own outputs.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the pretrain–posttrain boundary. Prior work showed that base models are often better calibrated than instruction-tuned models, but the mechanism was underspecified. This work separates parameter changes from formatting effects and finds that instruction tuning is the dominant source of calibration degradation, while the chat template further worsens it. For foundation-model training, the result is useful because it shows that posttraining can inject a behavioral prior toward confident assistant-style answering, not just improve task accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares base and instruction-tuned variants from the same model families, and runs the instruction-tuned models both with and without the chat template. This isolates three effects: the pretrained model, the posttraining algorithm, and the conversational role format. Calibration is measured on multiple-choice tasks using answer-token probabilities, ECE, and Brier score. The authors also use explicit confidence elicitation to check that the finding is not an artifact of logit-based scoring. Their mechanism hypothesis is an ownership bias: the same answer receives higher confidence when it is framed as the assistant’s own response than when it is framed as a user-provided answer. The proposed mitigation is to elicit confidence by presenting the answer as user input rather than as the model’s own previous output.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover six base/instruct pairs: Llama 3.1 8B/70B, Qwen3 4B/30B, and Gemma 3 4B/27B. The paper reports three benchmarks and three confidence elicitation methods; the provided full-text excerpt gives detailed numbers for MMLU with logit-based calibration. Instruction tuning improves accuracy by 3.7% on average, but increases ECE by 13.1% and Brier score by 6.5%. Adding the chat template gives a smaller accuracy gain of 1.1%, while adding another 2.74% ECE and 1.5% Brier score. The total ECE increase from base to instruction-tuned with chat formatting is about 15.8%. The results support a clear accuracy–calibration tradeoff introduced mainly by posttraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the experimental design that separates base, instruction-tuned without chat, and instruction-tuned with chat; Table 1 for the accuracy/ECE/Brier tradeoff; and the ownership-bias analysis plus the user-framing mitigation. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is not the exact MMLU score, but the evidence that posttraining changes confidence behavior in a structured way. This points to possible fixes in instruction data design, assistant-role formatting, loss weighting, or calibration-aware posttraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 ownership bias 结果；它会改变对 self-eval 置信度的默认信任，但还不到训练 recipe 级结论。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and ownership-bias results; it weakens trust in self-evaluated confidence, but it is not yet a training-recipe result.

paper.title: Capability Self-Assessment: Teaching LLMs to Know Their Limits
paper.abstract: The ability to recognize one's own limitations and decide whether to solve a problem or delegate is fundamental for reliable intelligent systems. Yet we show that modern large language models systematically lack this ability: across diverse model families and scales, they overestimate their competence and attempt queries they cannot solve. We refer to this ability as Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) and formulate it as a policy-learning problem, aiming to improve self-assessment while preserving

summary.core_problem: 现代 LLM 系统性地高估自身能力——即使在它们无法可靠解决的问题上，模型也倾向于选择回答而非放弃。这种能力自我评估（Capability Self-Assessment, CSA）的缺失导致过度生成幻觉和计算浪费。现有校准/置信度估计工作不把自我评估视为独立的能力学习问题，而指令微调/拒答工作常把行为混入特定任务。
summary.importance: 把 LLM 能力边界的自我认知形式化为一个独立的策略学习问题，而非分类或校准问题，并证明 RL（特别是 RLVR）可以有效教会模型这一能力同时保留原始解题能力。这对基座训练后的后训练阶段有启发——自我评估能力可以被习得并用于推断时路由和训练时数据选择。
summary.technical_approach: CSA 被形式化为二选一的策略学习问题：模型对每个 query 选择 Self-SOLVE（自己尝试）或 DELEGATE（交给更强模型）。Ground-truth 标签通过预训练模型自身的 K 次采样表现（pass@K 或多数投票）来构建。论文对比了四种训练策略：(a) SFT on label（直接输出决策）、(b) SFT on rationale（带推理的 SFT）、(c) SFT on CoT label（链式思考+决策）、(d) RLVR（使用可验证奖励的强化学习）。核心论点是 SFT 虽然能模仿决策标签，但会严重损害模型的原始解题能力；而 RLVR 通过基于结果的奖励（Self-SOLVE 当且仅当模型实际能解题时才受奖励）同时保留原能力并学会 CSA。
summary.experiments: 在多种模型家族、规模（从小到大）和领域上验证：(1) RL 显著优于 SFT 基线，在提升 CSA 准确性的同时保留原始解题能力；(2) SFT 会严重损害模型被评估的目标能力；(3) 学到的 CSA 策略能跨领域迁移，说明它不是领域特定启发式；(4) 实际应用：推断时的本地-云端路由（更好的 cost-accuracy 权衡）和训练时的能力感知数据选择（DELEGATE 样本位于能力边界附近）。具体 benchmark 数字和模型细节需在全文中查看。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 2 的经验发现（LLM 系统性高估自身能力的诊断）；Section 3 的训练策略对比，特别是为什么 SFT 失败而 RL 成功的机制分析；Section 4 的两个实际应用（路由和数据选择）。预计阅读时间 40-50 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息在提供内容中未明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern LLMs systematically overestimate their capabilities—even on queries they cannot reliably solve, models choose to answer rather than defer. This lack of Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) leads to excessive hallucination and wasted compute. Existing calibration/confidence estimation work does not treat self-assessment as an independent capability-learning problem, and instruction tuning/abstention work typically mixes the behavior into specific tasks.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes self-awareness of capability boundaries as a standalone policy-learning problem (not classification or calibration), and demonstrates that RL (specifically RLVR) can effectively teach this capability while preserving the model's original problem-solving ability. It informs post-training design—self-assessment capability is learnable and useful for both inference routing and training-time data selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: CSA is formulated as a binary policy-learning problem: for each query, the model chooses between Self-SOLVE (attempt itself) and DELEGATE (hand off to a stronger model). Ground-truth labels are constructed by probing the pre-trained model's own K-sample performance (pass@K or majority vote). Four training strategies are compared: (a) SFT on label (direct decision output); (b) SFT on rationale (SFT with reasoning); (c) SFT on CoT label (chain-of-thought plus decision); (d) RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards). The key argument: SFT can mimic decision labels but severely degrades the underlying problem-solving ability, while RLVR preserves it via outcome-based feedback—Self-SOLVE is only rewarded when the model can actually solve the query.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across model families, scales (small to large), and domains: (1) RL significantly outperforms SFT baselines, improving CSA accuracy while preserving original problem-solving ability; (2) SFT severely degrades the very capability being assessed; (3) the learned CSA policy transfers across domains, indicating it is not a domain-specific heuristic; (4) practical applications in local-cloud routing (better cost-accuracy tradeoff) and capability-aware training data selection (DELEGATE samples lie near the capability boundary). Specific benchmark numbers should be looked up in the full paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the empirical diagnosis of systematic capability overestimation; Section 3 for the training-strategy comparison, especially the mechanism of why SFT fails and RL succeeds; Section 4 for the two practical applications (routing and data selection). Estimated reading time 40-50 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not available in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫实验设计，尤其 RL vs SFT 的能力保持；若结果稳，内部路由和拒答训练应加入 CSA ablation。
recommendation.en: Skim the experimental setup, especially RL versus SFT on capability retention; if stable, CSA should enter internal routing and abstention ablations.

paper.title: Human-Alignment, Calibration, and Activation Patterns in Large Language Model Uncertainty
paper.abstract: Uncertainty Quantification is a large and growing subfield of large language model behavioral analysis. Primarily to recognize and combat hallucination, the field has largely focused on measuring and improving calibration, the accuracy of uncertainty judgments to task efficacy. In this work, we investigate the relatively underexplored question of how similar large language model uncertainty is to human uncertainty. We investigate the presence and strength of human-similar uncertainty signals, de

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 的不确定性信号是否不仅校准于任务正确率，还与人类不确定性感受对齐，以及指令微调如何改变这种关系。
summary.importance: 属于机制分析工作，切入点是 hallucination 与 uncertainty 的内部表征。对预训练研究员的价值不在方法本身，而在于它可能揭示 instruction tuning 改写了哪些不确定性表征。
summary.technical_approach: 从两个层面分析：一是外显行为层面的 uncertainty alignment 与 calibration，二是内部激活模式中是否存在与人类相似的不确定性信号；并比较指令微调前后的变化，在多选题和开放式事实回忆数据上做分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称和提升幅度。可确认的是实验覆盖多种任务形式，并同时考察行为指标与 activation-level 信号，重点是相关性和对齐分析而非提出新训练方法。
summary.authors_note: Vanderbilt University 与 Tennessee Technological University 团队。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper asks whether LLM uncertainty signals are not only calibrated to correctness but also aligned with human uncertainty, and how instruction tuning changes that relationship.
summary_en.importance: It is a mechanism/analysis paper centered on hallucination and uncertainty. The value for pretraining researchers is indirect: it may reveal how instruction tuning reshapes internal uncertainty representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study analyzes uncertainty at two levels: overt behavioral uncertainty alignment/calibration and internal activation patterns that may encode human-like uncertainty. It compares these properties before and after instruction fine-tuning across multiple-choice and open-ended factual recall settings.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or effect sizes. What is clear is that the evaluation spans multiple task formats and jointly studies behavioral metrics and activation-level signals, with analysis rather than a new training recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Vanderbilt University and Tennessee Technological University.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 SFT 是否把 pretrain 学到的 uncertainty 信号改坏了，可以看；先读实验设定和 activation 分析，别对因果结论下太重注。
recommendation.en: Read it if you care whether SFT distorts uncertainty signals learned in pretraining; focus on the setup and activation analysis, but treat causal claims cautiously.

paper.title: Counterfactual Graph for Multi-Agent LLM Calibration
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems often treat agreement as evidence: when many agents in a panel give the same answer, that answer is assumed to be more reliable. We show that this assumption can fail after agents communicate. Communication can induce correlated failures and false consensus, so the same vote share may reflect reliable agreement in one topology but over-confidence in another. We propose CAGE-CAL, a counterfactual agent-graph calibration framework for multi-agent LLMs. For each query, CAGE-

summary.core_problem: 解决多 Agent LLM 系统中“多数一致即更可靠”的置信度估计在通信后失效的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多 Agent 校准方法。它指出 Agent 间通信会引入相关错误和虚假共识，使 vote share 不能直接解释为置信度；这对 multi-agent debate、committee 和 tool-agent 系统的可靠性评估有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CAGE-CAL，即 counterfactual agent-graph calibration。对每个 query，比较观察到的 post-communication agent graph 与匹配的 no-communication counterfactual graph，建模 pairwise failure correlations 和 group-level dependencies；校准时不直接数同意票，而是估计通信带来的依赖结构反事实 shift，再据此调整 confidence。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个 benchmark 上评估。摘要称 CAGE-CAL 提升 reliability discrimination，ECE 保持竞争力；校准后的 confidence 还能进一步改善下游决策。未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Connecticut 和 University of Massachusetts Amherst；Chuxu Zhang、Hong Yu 等作者长期做 NLP/图学习/AI 系统相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses confidence calibration failures in multi-agent LLM systems where post-communication agreement is treated as evidence of correctness.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multi-agent calibration method. It shows that communication can induce correlated failures and false consensus, so raw vote share is not a reliable confidence signal in debate, committee, or agent-panel systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAGE-CAL builds a counterfactual agent-graph calibration framework. For each query, it compares the observed post-communication graph with a matched no-communication counterfactual graph, capturing pairwise failure correlations and group-level dependencies. It estimates the counterfactual shift in dependency induced by communication and calibrates confidence from that shift rather than from agreement counts alone.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on five benchmarks. The abstract reports improved reliability discrimination, competitive ECE, and downstream gains from calibrated confidence, but does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, or exact improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of Connecticut and University of Massachusetts Amherst; Chuxu Zhang and Hong Yu have prior work in NLP, graph learning, and AI systems.

recommendation.zh: 多 Agent 的一致性先验又被削弱一次；不必通读，记住通信会污染投票置信度。
recommendation.en: Another useful warning against agreement-as-confidence in multi-agent setups; no need to read fully, but remember communication contaminates votes.

paper.title: Calibrated Preference Learning: The Case of Label Ranking
paper.abstract: Calibration, the alignment of predicted probabilities with true outcome frequencies, is essential for reliable decision-making. While extensively studied for classification and regression, calibration has not been formally addressed for probabilistic label ranking, where the goal is to predict a distribution over orderings of a label set. Naively treating rankings as classes ignores their structure and fails to capture important modalities such as pairwise and top-k predictions. We formalize cal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论概率标签排序的校准问题：当模型输出一个关于多个候选项排列的概率分布时，预测概率是否与真实频率一致。它特别指出，不能简单把每个完整排序当成一个分类类别，因为排序有子结构，例如 pairwise preference、sub-ranking 和 top-k。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身影响有限，但对 post-train 中的偏好建模有启发。RLHF 和 reward model 常把人类反馈简化成成对比较，而成对偏好只是完整排序的一种投影。如果 reward model 在 pairwise 层面看起来可靠，却在 full ranking 或 top-k 层面失校准，下游 RL 使用的训练信号会有系统偏差。这个工作提供了一套更细的校准语言，适合分析多候选回答排序、偏好分歧、pluralistic alignment，以及 reward model uncertainty 是否可信。
summary.technical_approach: 作者形式化 Probabilistic Label Ranking。给定上下文 x 和 item 集合，模型输出所有排列上的概率分布。核心贡献是定义不同粒度的校准概念，而不是沿用多分类校准。粒度包括完整排序校准、子集合上的 sub-ranking 校准、top-k 校准，以及由强校准和弱校准衍生出的层级关系。理论部分证明 full-rank calibration 能推出较弱粒度的校准，但反过来不成立；sub-ranking calibration 和 top-k calibration 之间不可比较。作者还讨论了 Plackett-Luce 与 Mallows 等常见排序模型，并指出 pairwise-comparison 训练与 Plackett-Luce 之间的联系。这使得该框架可以覆盖 reward model 中常见的成对偏好学习。
summary.experiments: 实验部分评估了常见概率排序学习器的校准行为，并把分析扩展到一个 RLHF reward model benchmark。可确认的主要结论是，不同粒度的校准会给出不同判断：模型可能在某些 pairwise 或 sub-ranking 事件上较好，却不能保证完整排序分布校准；top-k 校准也不能替代 sub-ranking 校准。提供的内容没有给出具体数据表和数值，因此不宜复述未确认的提升幅度或误差值。实验价值在于展示理论层级不是形式化细节，而会改变对 reward model 可靠性的诊断。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看校准定义、Figure 1 或对应的层级关系图，以及证明 full-rank、sub-ranking、top-k 校准关系的命题。若关心 RLHF，直接跳到 reward model benchmark 的实验小节，看他们如何把排序校准指标落到偏好模型上。证明细节可以按需阅读；除非正在设计 reward model 的 calibration metric，否则不需要深挖全部反例构造。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper formalizes calibration for probabilistic label ranking. When a model predicts a distribution over rankings, the question is whether its probabilities match empirical outcome frequencies at the level of full rankings, sub-rankings, pairwise preferences, or top-k outcomes. Treating each full permutation as a flat class misses this structure.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, but it is useful for preference modeling and RLHF. Reward models often learn from pairwise comparisons, yet pairwise preferences are only projections of richer ranking distributions. A model can appear calibrated for pairwise events while being miscalibrated for full rankings or top-k decisions. This matters when reward uncertainty is used for data selection, active preference collection, pluralistic alignment, or RL training. The paper provides a vocabulary for diagnosing the quality of preference signals rather than only their accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define probabilistic label ranking as a conditional distribution over permutations of an item set. They then introduce calibration notions at multiple granularities: full-ranking calibration, calibration over subsets of items, and top-k calibration. These definitions extend strong and weak calibration from multiclass prediction while preserving the combinatorial structure of rankings. The theoretical analysis establishes implication and non-implication relations among the notions. Full-ranking calibration implies weaker forms, but the converse does not hold. Sub-ranking calibration and top-k calibration are incomparable. The paper also discusses common probabilistic ranking families such as Plackett-Luce and Mallows, and relates Plackett-Luce to pairwise-comparison learning, which is the setting most relevant to reward models.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section evaluates calibration behavior for popular probabilistic ranking learners and includes an analysis of reward models on an RLHF benchmark. The main reported pattern is that calibration depends strongly on the chosen ranking modality. A model may be acceptable under pairwise or sub-ranking calibration while still failing to represent the full ranking distribution faithfully. Top-k calibration also captures a different property from sub-ranking calibration. The supplied content does not include the numerical tables, so exact error values or gains should not be inferred. The experimental contribution is to show that the theoretical distinctions affect practical diagnostics for preference models.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is enough for most LLM researchers. Focus on the formal definitions of ranking calibration and the hierarchy diagram, especially the implications and separations between full-ranking, sub-ranking, and top-k calibration. For RLHF relevance, read the empirical subsection on reward models and check how the proposed metrics are computed from preference predictions. The proofs are worth reading only if one needs to design or audit calibration metrics for ranking-based reward models.

recommendation.zh: 后训练奖励模型校准的重要基础工作，建议重点阅读校准概念定义与RLHF实证部分的内容。
recommendation.en: Important foundational work on post-training reward model calibration, focus on the calibration concept definition and RLHF empirical sections.

paper.title: Locally Coherent, Globally Incoherent: Bounding Compositional Incoherence in Multi-Component LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-component LLM agents assemble probabilistic claims from components that each see only part of a joint problem; the composition can violate basic probability axioms even when every component is locally coherent. We formalise this locally coherent, globally incoherent failure via the compositional residual eps*, the L2 distance from the composed quote to the joint coherent polytope, computable at runtime from system output and the declared cross-component coupling constraints. A product-stru

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 multi-component LLM agent 的组合一致性问题：每个子组件单独看都可以是局部 coherent 的，组合起来却可能违反基本概率公理。作者把这种现象叫作 locally coherent, globally incoherent。它要解决的不是单个模型的校准，也不是常见的 self-consistency，而是当 planner、retriever、forecaster、tool caller 等不同模块分别给出局部概率判断后，系统级聚合结果是否仍然对应某个合法联合分布。论文给出的核心对象是 compositional residual ε*，即组合后的概率向量到 joint coherent polytope 的 L2 距离，并把它作为运行时可计算的系统级失真证书。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接影响有限，但对后训练、agent 评测和模型输出校准有方法论意义。它提醒人们：单组件 calibration 或 per-call proper scoring 并不能推出系统级 coherence，尤其在多模型、多工具、多子任务拼装的 agent 里，这个缺口会变成真实的决策风险。对做 LLM system research 的人，论文的价值主要在两个方面。第一，它把“组合后是否自洽”写成一个可计算、可修复、可检验的几何问题，而不是停留在案例分析。第二，它给出何时局部一致性足够、何时一定不够的结构性判据，即 polytope 是否可分解成 Cartesian product。这对设计 agent decomposition、路由边界和后处理层有参考意义。若从 pretrain 角度看，启发更多在 evaluation protocol 和 system-level objective，而不是训练 recipe 本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是形式化。作者把一组带逻辑关系的 Bernoulli 问题组成 clique，定义满足这些关系的所有联合可实现边缘概率集合为 coherent polytope。每个子组件只负责其中一部分坐标，先在本地做 Joint-Coherent Decoding，也就是把 K 次采样得到的经验边缘概率投影回本地 coherent polytope，保证局部无 Dutch-book 暴露。第二层是组合理论。论文证明了一个 product-structure dichotomy：在 owner-selected aggregation 设定下，如果 joint polytope 恰好分解为各局部 polytope 的笛卡尔积，那么局部 coherence 足以保证全局 coherence；只要耦合更紧，这个结论就不成立，必然存在每个组件都局部 coherent、但组合后全局 incoherent 的例子。作者进一步给出闭式的 residual magnitude 预测，用 Rayleigh quotient 形式把期望残差与 specialist panel covariance 联系起来。第三层是运行时修复与检验。给定组合后的 quote 和跨组件约束，直接计算其到 joint coherent polytope 的 L2 投影，得到 residual ε*；再用 hierarchical Boyle-Dykstra projection 做确定性修复，把组合结果投影回可行域。论文还构造了一个 anytime-valid 的 e-process sequential test，用于在任意停止时刻控制误报，判断系统是否出现组合不一致。与一般 calibration 方法不同，这套方法显式利用跨组件逻辑约束；与简单 renormalization 不同，它处理的是一般逻辑关系下的凸约束，而不只是概率和为 1 这种最简单情形。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 1,876 个 ensemble cliques，数据来自 Paleka 和 Polymarket，使用四个当代 foundation models，并按四类逻辑关系分层：partition、negation、disjunction、conjunction。经验结果与理论预测基本对齐。难度排序为 partition >> negation >> disjunction >> conjunction，作者解释为不同关系对 joint polytope 的约束强弱不同。Rayleigh-quotient 的残差量级预测在三类关系上与观测到的 expected residual 误差在 7% 以内；conjunction 上出现 0.83× 的 under-shoot，作者认为这也符合其 interior-Π̄ regime 的理论预期。系统级 Dutch-book exposure 的上界 √m* ε* 在 naive composition 下平均为 0.137，经 hierarchical projection 后降到 QP solver 的数值下限。论文还报告了 per-cell Brier score，并用 Diebold-Mariano 检验做配对显著性比较；另外做了 same-model decoupling control、leakage filtering 和 tool-augmented A/B，尽量排除由数据泄漏或模型差异带来的伪效应。需要注意的是，这些实验更像 system-level probabilistic evaluation，而不是标准 LLM 任务准确率比较，因此读的时候要把关注点放在 residual、exposure、projection repair 的行为上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，先把 coherent polytope、compositional residual、owner-selected aggregation 这几个定义吃透，否则后面的定理会显得很抽象。然后直接看 Theorem 3.3 对应的 product-structure dichotomy，这是全文最关键的结构性结论：什么时候局部一致性足够，什么时候从原理上就不够。接着看 Corollary 3.9 的 Rayleigh-quotient 预测和 Theorem 3.10 的 hierarchical Boyle-Dykstra repair，前者解释“残差有多大”，后者回答“怎么修”。实验部分重点看 Figure 2 和 relation-class 分层结果，再看 same-model control 与 leakage filtering，确认现象不是评测工件。若只是想判断是否与自己工作相关，45 分钟左右足够；若要真正复现或把这套东西接到 agent pipeline 里，附录里的优化细节、QP 设置和 sequential test 定义需要认真读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a system-level failure mode in multi-component LLM agents: each component can be locally coherent on the subset of questions it handles, yet their composition can violate basic probability axioms. The target is not standard calibration of a single model call, but coherence after aggregation across planners, specialists, tools, or forecasters that only observe partial structure. The central object is the compositional residual, ε*, defined as the L2 distance from the composed quote to the joint coherent polytope. This residual serves as a runtime certificate of whether the assembled system output is globally probabilistically valid.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is modest, but it is useful for post-training, agent evaluation, and system design. The main lesson is that per-component calibration, self-consistency, or proper scoring does not imply coherent behavior after composition. In modular LLM systems, that gap can become an operational risk rather than a theoretical curiosity. The paper contributes a concrete geometric lens: global coherence can be measured, bounded, and repaired using only the composed outputs and declared cross-component constraints. It also gives a structural criterion for when local coherence is sufficient, namely when the joint feasible set factorizes as a Cartesian product of local polytopes. For researchers building multi-call systems, routing schemes, or probabilistic judges, that is the part with practical value.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three parts. First, it formalizes a clique of Bernoulli questions linked by logical relations, and defines the coherent polytope as the set of marginal probability vectors realizable by some joint distribution consistent with those relations. Each component produces local empirical marginals from K samples, and local Joint-Coherent Decoding projects those marginals onto the local coherent polytope to remove within-component incoherence. Second, the paper proves a product-structure dichotomy. Under owner-selected aggregation, local coherence guarantees global coherence for all inputs if and only if the joint coherent polytope factorizes into a Cartesian product of local polytopes. Once tighter cross-component coupling exists, there are necessarily cases where every component is locally coherent but the composition is globally incoherent. The paper then derives a closed-form magnitude prediction for the residual in Rayleigh-quotient form, linked to specialist-panel covariance. Third, it provides runtime repair and testing. Given a composed quote and cross-component constraints, the system computes ε* by projecting onto the joint coherent polytope. A hierarchical Boyle-Dykstra projection deterministically repairs the quote by moving it back into the feasible set. An anytime-valid e-process gives a sequential test for coherence violations with false-positive control at arbitrary stopping times. Compared with ordinary calibration methods, the key difference is that this framework explicitly reasons over cross-component logical constraints rather than isolated outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses 1,876 ensemble cliques drawn from Paleka and Polymarket, evaluated with four contemporary foundation models and stratified by four logical relation classes: partition, negation, disjunction, and conjunction. The observed hardness ordering is partition >> negation >> disjunction >> conjunction, matching the intuition that tighter joint constraints create larger room for compositional failure. The Rayleigh-quotient prediction matches the observed expected residual within 7% on three of the four relation classes. For conjunction, the prediction undershoots at 0.83x, which the authors argue is itself consistent with their interior-regime theory. The Dutch-book exposure upper bound, sqrt(m*) ε*, averages 0.137 under naive composition and is reduced to the quadratic-program solver floor after hierarchical projection. The paper also reports per-cell Brier scores with Diebold-Mariano significance testing, and includes same-model decoupling controls, leakage filtering, and a tool-augmented A/B setup to rule out simpler explanations. These are system-level probabilistic diagnostics rather than standard task-accuracy comparisons, so the right quantities to track are residuals, exposure bounds, and repair behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and preliminaries until the coherent polytope and compositional residual are clear. Then read the theorem giving the product-structure dichotomy; that is the main conceptual result and tells you when local coherence can or cannot scale to the whole system. After that, jump to the Rayleigh-quotient residual prediction and the hierarchical Boyle-Dykstra repair. Those sections answer how large the failure should be and how to fix it. In the experiments, focus on the relation-class stratification and the projection-based repair results, then check the controls for leakage and same-model decoupling. Around 45 minutes is enough to understand the main idea and decide whether it matters for your agent stack. A deeper implementation-oriented read requires the appendices, especially the optimization details and the sequential testing setup.

recommendation.zh: 把“多组件 agent 概率拼接会坏掉”量化成可在线算的 ε* 并给出投影修复，够工程化；只读定义+修复算法与 §5 的失效率统计。
recommendation.en: It turns the hand-wavy “probability composition breaks” in multi-component agents into an online-computable ε* plus a projection-based repair; read the metric/repair and the §5 failure-rate stats.

paper.title: Evaluating the Relevance of Uncertainty Estimators for LLM Hallucination
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to hallucinations, i.e., statements unsupported by the input or training data, hindering reliable deployment. In parallel, numerous uncertainty estimation (UE) methods have been proposed to quantify model confidence and are often implicitly treated as proxies for model failure. However, the relationship between uncertainty and hallucinations remains insufficiently characterized. We present a systematic empirical study of the association between uncertainty

summary.core_problem: 系统检验 LLM 不确定性估计能否作为幻觉检测代理，而不是默认二者天然相关。
summary.importance: 这是幻觉与校准的实证机制分析。它对训练目标、拒答策略、verifier 设计和后训练奖励信号质量都有间接价值，因为很多 pipeline 会把 uncertainty 当作错误或幻觉的替代信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较多类 uncertainty estimators，包括信息论估计、采样型估计和反思型估计，并分别考察 intrinsic hallucination，即违反输入忠实性，以及 extrinsic hallucination，即相对训练数据或外部事实缺乏支持的说法。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验覆盖四个互补设置，但给出的片段未列出具体数据集、模型、baseline 或数值结果。核心实验设计是直接测量各类不确定性估计与不同幻觉类型之间的关联强度，而不是预设 UE 等同于失败检测。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Centre Inria de l’Université Grenoble Alpes。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically tests whether uncertainty estimation is a valid proxy for hallucination detection in LLMs, rather than assuming the relationship.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical mechanism study on hallucination and calibration. It matters indirectly for training objectives, abstention policies, verifier design, and reward-signal quality because many pipelines treat uncertainty as a stand-in for model failure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare several classes of uncertainty estimators, including information-theoretic, sampling-based, and reflexive estimators. They evaluate both intrinsic hallucinations, where outputs violate input faithfulness, and extrinsic hallucinations, where claims are unsupported relative to training data or external knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the experiments cover four complementary settings, but the provided excerpt does not list the exact datasets, models, baselines, or numerical outcomes. The key design is to directly measure the association between uncertainty estimators and hallucination types instead of assuming UE is a failure detector.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Centre Inria de l’Université Grenoble Alpes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫实验矩阵；若 UE 与幻觉弱相关，很多基于置信度的 reward/verifier 设计都要降权。
recommendation.en: Skim the experiment matrix; if UE correlates weakly with hallucination, confidence-based rewards and verifiers deserve much less trust.

institutions: Centre Inria de l’Université Grenoble Alpes

paper.title: Confidence and Calibration of Activation Oracles for Reliable Interpretation of Language Model Internals
paper.abstract: Activation oracles aim to make the activations of other models legible to humans and yield promising results compared to white-box interpretability techniques. However, uncertainty quantification (UQ) for the natural-language outputs of such activation oracles is so far understudied. Here, we investigate 6 different methods for estimating the confidence of activation oracles and evaluate how well-calibrated their confidence scores are. Our experiments on 6,000 samples per oracle (varying verbali

summary.core_problem: 激活oracle是将目标大模型隐藏状态翻译为自然语言的可解释性工具，其推理时残差流会被注入其他模型的激活向量，属于受 steering 扰动的特殊模型。目前这类模型输出的置信度估计与校准问题尚未被研究，而其下游对齐审计、欺骗检测、隐藏目标提取等场景都依赖可靠的置信度信号支撑决策。
summary.importance: 提供了激活oracle场景下的首个不确定性量化基准，验证了普通LLM常用置信度方法在steered模型上的适用性，复现了普通LLM上已观测到的口头自报告置信度偏差现象，给出了可直接落地的校准方法选型依据，对预训练模型可解释性工具的工程落地有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 选取6种置信度估计方法进行对比：3种为普通LLM常用基线的适配版本，包括答案词联合对数概率、温度引导的bootstrap众数频率、自由形式数值自报告；另外3种为针对steered激活oracle设计的新方法，包括MCMC功率采样链接受率、多MCMC链交叉一致性、steering系数扫描的解码稳定性。所有方法在禁忌词探测任务上测试，采用ECE、Brier分数、AUROC等校准与排序指标评估。
summary.experiments: 在已发布的Qwen3-8B激活oracle和新训练的Qwen3.6-27B激活oracle上测试，每个配置跑6000个样本。结果显示温度bootstrap是校准效果最好的方法：8B模型下采样温度T=1.0时ECE为5.7%，远优于对数概率基线的25.5%；27B模型下T=1.5时ECE为10.3%，优于对数概率基线的13.1%。自由形式数值自报告校准效果最差，27B模型上对错误答案的平均置信度（98.9%）甚至高于正确答案（97.6%）。专门设计的MCMC接受率等steered专属方法效果不佳，因为steered后的输出条件分布在贪心答案处过于尖锐，无法区分正确与错误输出，AUROC仅为0.53-0.60。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节的校准性能对比结果，以及第4节对不同方法失效原因的分析。预计阅读时间15-20分钟，不需要深入研究激活oracle的训练细节，核心关注置信度方法的选型结论和steered模型的特殊校准特性即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation oracles are fine-tuned language models that translate target models' hidden states into natural language for interpretability. As steered models whose residual streams are perturbed with activations from another model at inference, they lack validated uncertainty quantification (UQ) pipelines, even though downstream use cases including alignment auditing, deception detection, and hidden objective extraction require calibrated confidence signals to support actionable decisions.
summary_en.importance: This work presents the first UQ benchmark for activation oracles, validates the performance of common LLM confidence estimation methods under the steered setting, replicates the verbalized confidence gap previously observed in standard LLMs, and provides a practical recipe for calibrated UQ method selection. It offers practical reference for engineering deployment of interpretability tools for pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Six confidence estimation methods are benchmarked: three adapted from standard LLM UQ baselines, including joint token log-probability of predicted answers, temperature-bootstrap mode frequency, and free-form numeric self-report; three designed specifically for steered activation oracles, including MCMC power-sampling acceptance ratio, cross-chain agreement of multiple MCMC runs, and decoding stability across steering coefficient sweeps. All methods are tested on the secret-word taboo task and evaluated with calibration and ranking metrics including ECE, Brier score, and AUROC.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two activation oracles: a released Qwen3-8B oracle and a newly trained Qwen3.6-27B oracle, with 6,000 samples per configuration per model. Temperature-bootstrap mode frequency achieves the best calibration: it reaches 5.7% ECE on Qwen3-8B at sampling temperature T=1.0, far outperforming the 25.5% ECE of the log-probability baseline; on Qwen3.6-27B it reaches 10.3% ECE at T=1.5, outperforming the 13.1% ECE of the log-probability baseline. Free-form numeric self-report performs worst: on the 27B oracle, average confidence in wrong answers (98.9%) is higher than in correct answers (97.6%). Steered-specific methods such as MCMC acceptance ratio underperform, as the conditional distribution of steered outputs is sharply peaked at the greedy answer, making it unable to distinguish correct and wrong outputs, with AUROC only between 0.53 and 0.60.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for calibration performance comparisons and Section 4 for failure mode analysis of different UQ methods. Expected reading time is 15–20 minutes. No deep dive into activation oracle training details is required; focus on the method selection conclusions and unique calibration properties of steered models.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和校准表即可；它改变的是“解释器输出能否直接信任”的 prior，适合纳入内部 interp 工具评估。
recommendation.en: Read the method and calibration tables; it updates the prior on trusting interpreter outputs and fits internal interp-tool evaluation.

paper.title: Second Guess: Detecting Uncertainty Through Abstention and Answer Stability in Small Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models often generate confident but incorrect answers rather than abstaining when uncertain. This problem is particularly acute for small language models (SLMs), where computational constraints and autonomous operation amplify the need for reliable uncertainty detection. We propose _Second Guess_, a lightweight, parameter-free prompting technique for abstention in multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) that is well-suited for SLMs. Our key empirical insight is that models which

summary.core_problem: 在小语言模型的多选问答中，如何低成本识别不确定性并让模型在不知道时选择 abstain，而不是自信地答错。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但和不确定性估计、校准、后训练接口有关。贡献类型是轻量 prompting 方法与经验性机制观察：答案稳定性可作为是否知道的代理信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Second Guess，一种无参数的 prompting 技术：先观察模型在标准 MCQA 下的回答，再加入“I don't know”选项，利用答案是否稳定来判断模型是否真正知道答案；核心假设是知道答案的模型在选项扰动下更稳定，不确定模型更容易切换。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个 2B-8B 开源模型和 4 个 benchmark 上评测。摘要报告 composite risk 改善 10.81%，在 fine-tuned 模型上仍保持约 8% 改善，而基于 entropy 的方法在该设定下退化；收益在较弱模型上更明显。未给出具体模型名和数据集名。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Southern California 与 Information Sciences Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to detect uncertainty cheaply in small language models for multiple-choice QA, so the model can abstain instead of confidently answering incorrectly.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is adjacent to uncertainty estimation, calibration, and the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The contribution is a lightweight prompting method plus an empirical mechanism claim: answer stability can serve as a proxy for whether the model actually knows the answer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Second Guess is a parameter-free prompting technique. It compares the model’s answer under standard MCQA with its behavior when an 'I don’t know' option is added, using answer stability as the uncertainty signal. The key hypothesis is that models that truly know the answer remain stable under this option perturbation, while uncertain models become unstable.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four open models in the 2B-8B range and four benchmarks. The abstract reports a 10.81% improvement in composite risk, around 8% improvement even on fine-tuned models where entropy-based methods degrade, and larger gains for weaker models. Specific model names and dataset names are not given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Southern California and the Information Sciences Institute.

recommendation.zh: 方法很轻，像个 prompt trick，但“答案稳定性比熵更能测知道/不知道”这个点值得记；读实验主表即可，不必投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: This is basically a prompt trick, but the claim that answer stability beats entropy for know/don’t-know detection is worth remembering; read the main results table and move on.

paper.title: Is Capability a Liability? More Capable Language Models Make Worse Forecasts When It Matters Most
paper.abstract: We document inverse scaling in LLMs on forecasting problems whose underlying time series exhibit superlinear growth and tail risk of regime change, a structure common in finance and epidemiology. On these tasks, more capable models produce worse distributional forecasts. The pattern appears on ForecastBench-Sim (FBSim), a contamination-free, simulated-world benchmark we release, in forecasting synthetic SIR epidemics with a matched linear control, and replicates in real-world datasets on COVID-1

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个很具体、但对高风险决策很关键的问题：当预测对象具有超线性增长，并且上尾存在体制切换或突然反转风险时，能力更强的语言模型是否真的会给出更好的概率预测。作者给出的答案是否定的。论文不是在看普通 point forecast，而是在看 distributional forecasting，也就是整条预测分布，尤其是上尾分位数是否校准。核心发现是：模型能力越强，越容易对延续性增长过度承诺，把高分位数抬得过高；一旦真实过程随后发生回落或 regime change，CRPS 这类分布评分反而变差。这构成了一类结构上可解释的 inverse scaling，而不是依赖提示词技巧或对抗样本的人为现象。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它提醒人们：更强的通用能力并不自动转化为更好的不确定性建模，尤其是在尾部风险敏感的任务上。第二，它把问题定位到训练与后训练共同塑造的行为偏差上，而不是简单归因于知识不足；文中 2×2 的 Llama-3.1 对照说明，参数规模和 instruct/post-training 都会独立加剧这种上尾过冲。第三，它对评测方法有直接启发：如果只看二元阈值指标，如 Brier on a chosen threshold，很多失败模式会被掩盖，甚至得出相反结论。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口、校准、reward design、reasoning-style elicitation 的人，这篇文章的价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于明确指出了一个现有训练范式会系统性诱发的失真区域。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三条主线。第一条是基准构建。作者提出 ForecastBench-Sim，用 FreeCiv 的 AI-vs-AI rollout 生成无污染的世界状态，再把快照转成自然语言 world report，让模型预测未来多个 horizon 的结果分布。这样做的好处是：既保留了长时程、部分可观测、偶发冲击这些真实预测问题的结构，又避免了训练集污染和现实世界标签噪声。第二条是机制隔离。作者没有停留在 benchmark 相关性，而是用 synthetic SIR 流行病模型做受控实验，把“超线性增长+后续 regime change”与“线性增长+相同 crash 结构”分开。结果显示，只有前者稳定触发 inverse scaling，说明关键不是‘有崩盘’，而是模型先被加速增长轨迹吸引，再在上尾外推过度。第三条是归因设计。论文用跨家族 ECI 排序看总体趋势，再用 provider fixed effects、OpenAI 系列内部分析，以及 Llama-3.1 {70B, 405B} × {base, instruct} 的 2×2 设计，把 capability、provider、post-training 尽量拆开。分布预测通过五个分位数 p10/p25/p50/p75/p90 采样，CRPS 由分段线性 CDF 计算，并进一步用 pinball loss 做 per-quantile 分解，直接定位问题集中在上尾。提示干预方面，作者测试了 generic uncertainty cue 和 domain identity cue，发现前者几乎无效，后者只在部分领域有不稳定缓解，说明这不是简单靠‘提醒模型谨慎’就能修复的表层问题。
summary.experiments: 实验部分信息量很足。FBSim 上，汇总六种问题模板后，长预测跨度 H7 的能力—性能相关性在 CRPS 下为 ρ=-0.42，样本 N=28，说明能力越高整体分布预测越差；而 reasoning 打开后这一现象更强，附录给出 H7 上 ρ=-0.56，对作者假设是加固而不是削弱。更关键的是指标反转：同一批模型在 FBSim 上若用 Brier 评估，相关性变成 ρ=+0.45，N=27；甚至从同一连续分布导出的阈值 Brier 也会翻转符号，说明问题不在任务格式，而在单阈值指标看不到上尾失配。机制实验里，synthetic SIR 出现反向 scaling，而 matched linear control 不出现，支持‘超线性增长是触发器’。Llama-3.1 的 2×2 结果表明，405B 比 70B 更容易上尾抬升，instruct 比 base 也更明显，两者叠加最差。真实世界复现覆盖 COVID-19、麻疹、美国 2003–2006 房价泡沫、12 次恶性通胀 CPI；作者报告各域 Spearman ρ 及 95% bootstrap CI，且跨域区间都排除 0。一个很有辨识度的对照是流感：同属疾病时间序列，但由于 overshoot 不足，没有出现同样 inversion。提示干预方面，generic uncertainty cue 在所有域都未显著缓解；domain-specific identity 对 COVID 有帮助，对 housing/SIR/measles 只有部分缓解，对 hyperinflation 基本失败，即便模型在 48 次 probe 中有 46 次能识别出危机身份。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓三件事。第一，看引言和 Figure 2，先把核心现象吃透：不是整体分布都坏，而是 upper tail 被更强模型系统性抬高。第二，看 SIR 机制实验和 Llama-3.1 2×2 设计，这两部分决定这篇文章是否只是 benchmark 观察，还是对训练行为有更深解释；答案是后者。第三，看关于 CRPS、pinball loss 与 Brier 反转的讨论，这部分直接关系到以后怎么设计 forecasting 或 uncertainty-sensitive eval。若时间有限，优先读主文的 FBSim、SIR、Llama 2×2、真实世界复现四节，再扫 Appendix E/F 了解 provider fixed effects 和 reasoning-on 结果。预计 35–50 分钟可以完成有效泛读。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 instruct/post-training 为什么会放大上尾承诺，可能与偏好更明确、叙事更连贯、拒绝含糊回答有关；二是这种 failure 是否能通过 pretrain 目标、分布监督或 calibration-aware post-training 缓解。
summary.authors_note: 从正文可确认作者与 Oxford、Stanford 有联系；通讯作者邮箱显示包括 junchi.yu、philip.torr、jamesz。完整作者名单与机构映射在给定内容中未完全展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important failure mode: whether more capable language models produce better probabilistic forecasts when the underlying process shows superlinear growth and a nontrivial chance of regime change. The answer is no. The target is not point forecasting but distributional forecasting, with emphasis on whether the upper tail is calibrated. The central finding is that stronger models systematically push high quantiles upward, effectively overcommitting to continued growth. When the process later reverts or breaks, proper distributional scores such as CRPS get worse. This is presented as a structurally identifiable inverse-scaling regime, not a prompt artifact or an adversarial benchmark trick.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is threefold. First, stronger general capability does not imply better uncertainty modeling, especially on tail-sensitive tasks. Second, the paper ties the failure to training and post-training behavior rather than simple lack of knowledge; the controlled Llama-3.1 2×2 study shows that both scale and instruct-style post-training independently worsen upper-tail overshoot. Third, it is a warning about evaluation design: binary threshold metrics can hide, or even reverse, the true pattern. For people working on pretrain/post-train interfaces, calibration, reward shaping, or reasoning elicitation, the value here is not a new training recipe but a clearly isolated region where current recipes induce systematic distortion.
summary_en.technical_approach: The methodology has three main components. First, benchmark construction. ForecastBench-Sim is built from AI-vs-AI FreeCiv rollouts. A game state is frozen, converted into a natural-language world report, and the model is asked to forecast future outcomes at multiple horizons. This gives long-horizon uncertainty, partial observability, and occasional shocks, while avoiding contamination from real-world text corpora. Second, mechanism isolation. The authors move beyond benchmark correlation by using a synthetic SIR process to separate 'superlinear growth followed by regime change' from a matched 'linear growth with the same crash structure'. Inverse scaling appears only in the former, which supports the claim that the trigger is not merely the existence of a crash but the model being drawn into aggressive extrapolation during accelerating growth. Third, attribution. They use cross-family capability ranking via ECI, provider fixed effects, within-lineage replication, and a controlled Llama-3.1 {70B, 405B} × {base, instruct} design to disentangle capability, provider effects, and post-training. Forecasts are elicited as five quantiles, converted into a piecewise-linear CDF, scored with CRPS, and decomposed with pinball loss to localize the error to the upper tail. Prompt interventions include a generic uncertainty cue and domain-identity cues; neither provides a stable fix, which suggests the issue is deeper than surface prompting.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section is strong. On FBSim, pooling six question templates, the capability-performance correlation at long horizon H7 is ρ=-0.42 under CRPS with N=28 models, meaning stronger models are worse at full-distribution forecasting. When reasoning is enabled, the inversion becomes stronger; the appendix reports ρ=-0.56 at H7. The metric reversal is especially important: on the same benchmark, Brier yields ρ=+0.45 with N=27, and even thresholded Brier derived from the same continuous forecasts can flip the sign. That rules out task-format confounds and shows that single-threshold evaluation misses the upper-tail failure. In the mechanism study, synthetic SIR exhibits inverse scaling while the matched linear control does not, supporting the superlinear-growth trigger. In the Llama-3.1 2×2 study, 405B overshoots more than 70B, instruct more than base, and the combination is worst. Real-world replication covers COVID-19 incidence, pre-vaccine US measles, the 2003–2006 US housing bubble, and 12 hyperinflation episodes; the paper reports domain-wise Spearman correlations and 95% bootstrap confidence intervals, all excluding zero. Influenza serves as a useful negative control: similar domain, insufficient overshoot, no inversion. Prompt interventions are weak: generic uncertainty cues do not attenuate the effect, and domain-specific identity helps only inconsistently.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main upper-tail decomposition figure to understand the phenomenon precisely: the failure is concentrated in the upper quantiles, not the whole distribution. Second, read the synthetic SIR section and the Llama-3.1 2×2 study; these are what make the paper more than a benchmark observation. Third, read the discussion of CRPS, pinball loss, and the Brier sign reversal, because that part has direct implications for how forecasting and uncertainty-sensitive evaluation should be designed. If time is limited, the main text sections on FBSim, SIR, the Llama ablation, and real-world replication are enough, followed by a quick look at the appendices on provider fixed effects and reasoning-enabled results. A useful deeper question is why instruct/post-training amplifies upper-tail commitment; another is whether calibration-aware pretraining or distribution-level supervision could reduce this behavior.
